text: Huroof-e-Muqatta'at jo suraton ke shuru mein aate hain un par poori behas Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein hum kar chuke hain. Yahan dohrane ki zaroorat nahin. Quran-e-Kareem jo khuli hui wazeh roshan aur zahir kitab hai. Yeh uski aayatein hain jo mominon ke liye hidayat-o-basharat hain. Kyunke wahi is par imaan late hain, iski itteba karte hain, ise saccha jante hain, is mein hukm-o-ahkaam hain un par amal karte hain. Yehi woh log hain jo namazein sahih taur par padhte hain, farzon mein kami nahin karte, isi tarah farz-e-zakat bhi, daar-e-aakhirat par kamil yaqeen rakhte hain, maut ke baad ki zindagi aur jaza-o-saza ko bhi maante hain. Jannat-o-Dozakh ko haq jante hain. Chunancha aur riwayat mein bhi hai ke imandaron ke liye toh yeh Quran hidayat aur shifa hai aur be-imano ke kaan toh behre hain, un mein rui diye hue hain. Is se khushkhabri parhezgaron ko hai aur badkirdaron ko is mein darawa hai. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke jo ise jhutlayein aur Qayamat ke aane ko na maanein hum bhi unhein chhod dete hain, unki buraiyan unhein acchi lagne lagti hain. Isi mein woh badhte aur phoolte phalte rehte hain aur apni sarkashi aur gumrahi mein badhte rehte hain. Unki nigahein aur dil ulat jate hain, unhein duniya aur aakhirat mein badtareen sazayein hongi aur Qayamat ke din tamam ahl-e-mahshar mein sab se zyada khasare mein yehi rahenge. Beshak aap ae hamare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum se hi Quran le rahe hain. Hum Hakeem hain, amr-o-nahi ki hikmat ko bakhoobi jante hain, Aleem hain, chote bade tamam kamon se bakhoobi khabardar hain. Pas Quran ki tamam khabrein bilkul sidq-o-sadaqat wali hain aur iske hukm-o-ahkaam sab ke sab sarasar adl wale hain, jaise farman hai aayat (وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَّعَدْلًا ۭلَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمٰتِهٖ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ) (Surah (Al-An'am: 115).)

Aag lene gaye risalat mil gayi. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne mehboob (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Musa (A.S) ka waqia yaad dila raha hai ke Allah ne unhein kis tarah buzurg banaya aur un se kalam kiya aur unhein zabardast mojze ata farmaye aur Firaun aur Firauniyon ke paas apna rasool bana kar bheja lekin kuffar ne aap ka inkar kiya, apne kufr-o-takabbur se na hate, aap ki itteba aur pairvi na ki. Farmata hai ke jab Musa (A.S) apni ahl ko le kar chale aur rasta bhool gaye, raat aa gayi aur woh bhi sakht andhere wali. Toh aap ne dekha ke ek janib se aag ka shola sa dikhayi deta hai, aap ne apni ahl se farmaya ke tum toh yahin thehro. Main is roshni ke paas jata hoon, kya ajab ke wahan se jo ho us se rasta maloom ho jaye ya main wahan kuch aag le aaun ke tum usay zara senk-taap kar lo. Aisa hi hua ke aap wahan se ek badi khabar laye aur bahut bada noor hasil kiya. Farmata hai ke jab wahan pohanche, is manzar ko dekh kar hairan reh gaye, dekhte hain ke sarsabz darakht hai, us par aag lipti rahi, sholay tez ho rahe hain aur darakht ki sarsabzi aur barh rahi hai. Oonchi nigah ki toh dekha ke woh noor aasman tak pohancha hua hai. Filwaq'e woh aag na thi balkay noor tha aur noor bhi Wahdahu La Sharik ka. Hazrat Musa (A.S) muta'ajjib thay aur koi baat samajh mein nahin aati thi ke yakayak ek aawaz aati hai ke is noor mein jo kuch hai woh paki wala aur buzurgi wala hai aur us ke paas jo farishtay hain woh bhi muqaddas hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Allah sota nahin aur na usay sona laiq hai, woh tarazu ko past karta hai aur oonchi karta hai, raat ke kaam us ki taraf din se pehle aur din ke kaam raat se pehle charh jate hain. Us ka hijab noor ya aag hai, agar woh hat jayein toh us ke chehray ki tajalli har cheez ko jala de jis par us ki nigah pohanch rahi hai, yani kul kainat ko. Abu Ubaidah (R.A) rawi-e-hadith ne yeh hadith bayan farma kar yahi aayat tilawat ki. Yeh alfaaz Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ke hain aur is ki asal Sahih Muslim mein hai. Pak hai woh Allah jo tamam jahano ka palnehar hai, jo chahta hai karta hai, makhlooq mein se koi bhi us ke mushabah nahin. Us ki masnoo'aat mein se koi cheez kisi ke ihate mein nahin. Woh buland-o-bala hai, sari makhlooq se alag hai, zameen-o-aasman usay gher nahin sakte, woh Ahad-o-Samad hai, woh makhlooq ki mushabahat se pak hai. Phir khabar di ke khud Allah Ta'ala un se khitab farma raha hai, wahi usi waqt sargoshiyan kar raha hai jo sab par ghalib hai, sab us ke matahat aur zer-e-hukm hain. Woh apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein hikmat wala hai. Is ke baad Janab-e-Bari Azza-wa-Jal ne hukum diya ke ae Musa! Apni lakri ko zameen par daal do taake tum apni aankhon se dekh sako ke Allah Ta'ala fa'il-e-mukhtar hai, woh har cheez par qadir hai. Musa (A.S) ne irshad sunte hi lakri ko zameen par giraya. Isi waqt woh ek phan uthaye phunkarta hua saanp ban gayi aur bahut baray jism ka saanp, bari darauni soorat, is motapay par tez tez chalne wala.

Aisa jeeta jagta chalta phirta zabardast azdaha dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) khauf zada ho gaye. Jaan ka lafz Quran-e-Kareem mein hai, yeh ek qisam ke saanp hain jo bahut tezi se harkat karne wale aur kundi lagane wale hote hain. Ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne gharon mein rehne wale aise saanpon ke qatl se muman'at farmayi hai. Al-gharaz Janab Musa (A.S) ise dekh kar dare aur dehshat ke mare thehar na sake aur munh mod kar peeth pher kar wahan se bhaag khade huye, aise dehshat zada the ke mud kar bhi na dekha. Isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aawaz di ke Musa (A.S) daro nahin. Main toh tumhein apna barguzida Rasool aur zi-izzat paighambar banana chahta hoon. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, is aayat mein insaan ke liye bahut badi basharat hai ke jis ne bhi koi burai ka kaam kiya ho phir woh us par nadim ho jaye, us kaam ko chhod de, tauba kar le, Allah Ta'ala ki taraf jhuk jaye toh Allah Ta'ala uski tauba qabool farma leta hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa inni la-ghaffarul liman taba wa amana wa amila saliha thum-mahtada) (Taha: 82). Jo bhi tauba kare aur imaan laye aur nek amal kare aur rah-e-rast par chale main us ke gunahon ko bakhshne wala hoon. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa may-ya'mal su-an au yazlim nafsahu thum-ma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafoorar-Raheema) (An-Nisa: 110). Jo shakhs kisi burai ka murtakib ho jaye ya koi gunah kar baithe phir Allah Ta'ala se istighfar kare toh woh yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala ko Ghafoor-o-Raheem payega. Is mazmoon ki aayatein Kalam-e-Ilahi mein aur bhi bahut sari hain. Lakdi ke saanp ban jaane ke mojze ke sath hi Kaleemullah (A.S) ko aur mojza diya jata hai ke aap jab bhi apne gareban mein hath daal kar nikalein ge toh woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua nikalega. Yeh do mojze un nau mojzon mein se hain ke jin se main teri waqtan-fauqtan ta'eed karta rahunga. Taake fasiq Firaun aur us ki fasiq qoum ke dilon mein teri nabuwwat ka suboot jagah pakad jaye. Yeh nau mojze woh thay jin ka zikr aayat (Walaqad aatayna Musa tis'a aayatim bayyinatin fas-al Bani Israeela iz ja'ahum faqala lahu Firaunu inni la-azunnuka ya Musa mashoora) (Al-Isra: 101) mein hai, jis ki poori tafsir bhi is aayat ke tehat mein guzar chuki hai. Jab yeh wazeh, zahir, saaf aur khule mojze Firauniyon ko dikhaye gaye toh woh apni zid mein aa kar kehne lage yeh toh jadoo hai, lo hum apne jadugaron ko bula lete hain muqabla kar lo. Is muqable mein Allah ne haq ko ghalib kiya aur sab log zer ho gaye magar phir bhi na mane. Go dilon mein is ki haqqaniyat jam chuki thi, lekin zahir muqable se hate. Sirf zulm aur takabbur ki bina par haq ko jhutlate rahe. Ab toh dekh le ke in mufsidon ka anjam kis tarah hairat-naak aur kaisa kuch ibrat-naak hua? Ek hi martaba ek hi sath sare ke sare darya-burd kar diye gaye. Pas ae aakhri Nabi-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jhutlane walo! Tum is Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutla kar mutma'in na baitho.

Kyunke yeh toh Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bhi ashraf-o-afzal hain, un ki daleelein aur mojze bhi un ki daleelon aur mojzon se bade hain. Khud aap ka wajood, aap ke aadat-o-akhlaq aur agli kitabon ki aur agle nabiyon ki aap ki nisbat basharatein aur un se Allah ka ahd-o-paiman, yeh sab cheezein aap mein hain. Pas tumhein na maan kar nidar aur be-khauf na rehna chahiye.

Aisa jeeta jagta chalta phirta zabardast azdaha dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) khauf zada ho gaye. Jaan ka lafz Quran-e-Kareem mein hai, yeh ek qisam ke saanp hain jo bahut tezi se harkat karne wale aur kundi lagane wale hote hain. Ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne gharon mein rehne wale aise saanpon ke qatl se muman'at farmayi hai. Al-gharaz Janab Musa (A.S) ise dekh kar dare aur dehshat ke mare thehar na sake aur munh mod kar peeth pher kar wahan se bhaag khade huye, aise dehshat zada the ke mud kar bhi na dekha. Isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aawaz di ke Musa (A.S) daro nahin. Main toh tumhein apna barguzida Rasool aur zi-izzat paighambar banana chahta hoon. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, is aayat mein insaan ke liye bahut badi basharat hai ke jis ne bhi koi burai ka kaam kiya ho phir woh us par nadim ho jaye, us kaam ko chhod de, tauba kar le, Allah Ta'ala ki taraf jhuk jaye toh Allah Ta'ala uski tauba qabool farma leta hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa inni la-ghaffarul liman taba wa amana wa amila saliha thum-mahtada) (Taha: 82). Jo bhi tauba kare aur imaan laye aur nek amal kare aur rah-e-rast par chale main us ke gunahon ko bakhshne wala hoon. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa may-ya'mal su-an au yazlim nafsahu thum-ma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafoorar-Raheema) (An-Nisa: 110). Jo shakhs kisi burai ka murtakib ho jaye ya koi gunah kar baithe phir Allah Ta'ala se istighfar kare toh woh yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala ko Ghafoor-o-Raheem payega. Is mazmoon ki aayatein Kalam-e-Ilahi mein aur bhi bahut sari hain. Lakdi ke saanp ban jaane ke mojze ke sath hi Kaleemullah (A.S) ko aur mojza diya jata hai ke aap jab bhi apne gareban mein hath daal kar nikalein ge toh woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua nikalega. Yeh do mojze un nau mojzon mein se hain ke jin se main teri waqtan-fauqtan ta'eed karta rahunga. Taake fasiq Firaun aur us ki fasiq qoum ke dilon mein teri nabuwwat ka suboot jagah pakad jaye. Yeh nau mojze woh thay jin ka zikr aayat (Walaqad aatayna Musa tis'a aayatim bayyinatin fas-al Bani Israeela iz ja'ahum faqala lahu Firaunu inni la-azunnuka ya Musa mashoora) (Al-Isra: 101) mein hai, jis ki poori tafsir bhi is aayat ke tehat mein guzar chuki hai. Jab yeh wazeh, zahir, saaf aur khule mojze Firauniyon ko dikhaye gaye toh woh apni zid mein aa kar kehne lage yeh toh jadoo hai, lo hum apne jadugaron ko bula lete hain muqabla kar lo. Is muqable mein Allah ne haq ko ghalib kiya aur sab log zer ho gaye magar phir bhi na mane. Go dilon mein is ki haqqaniyat jam chuki thi, lekin zahir muqable se hate. Sirf zulm aur takabbur ki bina par haq ko jhutlate rahe. Ab toh dekh le ke in mufsidon ka anjam kis tarah hairat-naak aur kaisa kuch ibrat-naak hua? Ek hi martaba ek hi sath sare ke sare darya-burd kar diye gaye. Pas ae aakhri Nabi-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jhutlane walo! Tum is Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutla kar mutma'in na baitho.

Khud aap ka wajood, aap ke aadat-o-akhlaq aur agli kitabon ki aur agle nabiyon ki aap ki nisbat basharatein aur un se Allah ka ahd-o-paiman, yeh sab cheezein aap mein hain. Pas tumhein na maan kar nidar aur be-khauf na rehna chahiye.

Aisa jeeta jagta chalta phirta zabardast azdaha dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) khauf zada ho gaye. Jaan ka lafz Quran-e-Kareem mein hai, yeh ek qisam ke saanp hain jo bahut tezi se harkat karne wale aur kundi lagane wale hote hain. Ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne gharon mein rehne wale aise saanpon ke qatl se muman'at farmayi hai. Al-gharaz Janab Musa (A.S) ise dekh kar dare aur dehshat ke mare thehar na sake aur munh mod kar peeth pher kar wahan se bhaag khade huye, aise dehshat zada the ke mud kar bhi na dekha. Isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aawaz di ke Musa (A.S) daro nahin. Main toh tumhein apna barguzida Rasool aur zi-izzat paighambar banana chahta hoon. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, is aayat mein insaan ke liye bahut badi basharat hai ke jis ne bhi koi burai ka kaam kiya ho phir woh us par nadim ho jaye, us kaam ko chhod de, tauba kar le, Allah Ta'ala ki taraf jhuk jaye toh Allah Ta'ala uski tauba qabool farma leta hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa inni la-ghaffarul liman taba wa amana wa amila saliha thum-mahtada) (Taha: 82). Jo bhi tauba kare aur imaan laye aur nek amal kare aur rah-e-rast par chale main us ke gunahon ko bakhshne wala hoon. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa may-ya'mal su-an au yazlim nafsahu thum-ma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafoorar-Raheema) (An-Nisa: 110). Jo shakhs kisi burai ka murtakib ho jaye ya koi gunah kar baithe phir Allah Ta'ala se istighfar kare toh woh yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala ko Ghafoor-o-Raheem payega. Is mazmoon ki aayatein Kalam-e-Ilahi mein aur bhi bahut sari hain. Lakdi ke saanp ban jaane ke mojze ke sath hi Kaleemullah (A.S) ko aur mojza diya jata hai ke aap jab bhi apne gareban mein hath daal kar nikalein ge toh woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua nikalega. Yeh do mojze un nau mojzon mein se hain ke jin se main teri waqtan-fauqtan ta'eed karta rahunga. Taake fasiq Firaun aur us ki fasiq qoum ke dilon mein teri nabuwwat ka suboot jagah pakad jaye. Yeh nau mojze woh thay jin ka zikr aayat (Walaqad aatayna Musa tis'a aayatim bayyinatin fas-al Bani Israeela iz ja'ahum faqala lahu Firaunu inni la-azunnuka ya Musa mashoora) (Al-Isra: 101) mein hai, jis ki poori tafsir bhi is aayat ke tehat mein guzar chuki hai. Jab yeh wazeh, zahir, saaf aur khule mojze Firauniyon ko dikhaye gaye toh woh apni zid mein aa kar kehne lage yeh toh jadoo hai, lo hum apne jadugaron ko bula lete hain muqabla kar lo. Is muqable mein Allah ne haq ko ghalib kiya aur sab log zer ho gaye magar phir bhi na mane. Go dilon mein is ki haqqaniyat jam chuki thi, lekin zahir muqable se hate. Sirf zulm aur takabbur ki bina par haq ko jhutlate rahe. Ab toh dekh le ke in mufsidon ka anjam kis tarah hairat-naak aur kaisa kuch ibrat-naak hua? Ek hi martaba ek hi sath sare ke sare darya-burd kar diye gaye. Pas ae aakhri Nabi-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jhutlane walo! Tum is Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutla kar mutma'in na baitho.

Pas tumhein na maan kar nidar aur be-khauf na rehna chahiye.

Farmata hai ke jab wahan pohanche, is manzar ko dekh kar hairan reh gaye, dekhte hain ke sarsabz darakht hai, us par aag lipti rahi, sholay tez ho rahe hain aur darakht ki sarsabzi aur barh rahi hai. Oonchi nigah ki toh dekha ke woh noor aasman tak pohancha hua hai. Filwaq'e woh aag na thi balkay noor tha aur noor bhi Wahdahu La Sharik ka. Hazrat Musa (A.S) muta'ajjib thay aur koi baat samajh mein nahin aati thi ke yakayak ek aawaz aati hai ke is noor mein jo kuch hai woh paki wala aur buzurgi wala hai aur us ke paas jo farishtay hain woh bhi muqaddas hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke Allah sota nahin aur na usay sona laiq hai, woh tarazu ko past karta hai aur oonchi karta hai, raat ke kaam us ki taraf din se pehle aur din ke kaam raat se pehle charh jate hain. Us ka hijab noor ya aag hai, agar woh hat jayein toh us ke chehray ki tajalli har cheez ko jala de jis par us ki nigah pohanch rahi hai, yani kul kainat ko. Abu Ubaidah (R.A) rawi-e-hadith ne yeh hadith bayan farma kar yahi aayat tilawat ki. Yeh alfaaz Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ke hain aur is ki asal Sahih Muslim mein hai. Pak hai woh Allah jo tamam jahano ka palnehar hai, jo chahta hai karta hai, makhlooq mein se koi bhi us ke mushabah nahin. Us ki masnoo'aat mein se koi cheez kisi ke ihate mein nahin. Woh buland-o-bala hai, sari makhlooq se alag hai, zameen-o-aasman usay gher nahin sakte, woh Ahad-o-Samad hai, woh makhlooq ki mushabahat se pak hai. Phir khabar di ke khud Allah Ta'ala un se khitab farma raha hai, wahi usi waqt sargoshiyan kar raha hai jo sab par ghalib hai, sab us ke matahat aur zer-e-hukm hain. Woh apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein hikmat wala hai. Is ke baad Janab-e-Bari Azza-wa-Jal ne hukum diya ke ae Musa! Apni lakri ko zameen par daal do taake tum apni aankhon se dekh sako ke Allah Ta'ala fa'il-e-mukhtar hai, woh har cheez par qadir hai. Musa (A.S) ne irshad sunte hi lakri ko zameen par giraya. Isi waqt woh ek phan uthaye phunkarta hua saanp ban gayi aur bahut baray jism ka saanp, bari darauni soorat, is motapay par tez tez chalne wala.

Aisa jeeta jagta chalta phirta zabardast azdaha dekh kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) khauf zada ho gaye. Jaan ka lafz Quran-e-Kareem mein hai, yeh ek qisam ke saanp hain jo bahut tezi se harkat karne wale aur kundi lagane wale hote hain. Ek hadith mein hai ke Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne gharon mein rehne wale aise saanpon ke qatl se muman'at farmayi hai. Al-gharaz Janab Musa (A.S) ise dekh kar dare aur dehshat ke mare thehar na sake aur munh mod kar peeth pher kar wahan se bhaag khade huye, aise dehshat zada the ke mud kar bhi na dekha. Isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aawaz di ke Musa (A.S) daro nahin. Main toh tumhein apna barguzida Rasool aur zi-izzat paighambar banana chahta hoon. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai, is aayat mein insaan ke liye bahut badi basharat hai ke jis ne bhi koi burai ka kaam kiya ho phir woh us par nadim ho jaye, us kaam ko chhod de, tauba kar le, Allah Ta'ala ki taraf jhuk jaye toh Allah Ta'ala uski tauba qabool farma leta hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa inni la-ghaffarul liman taba wa amana wa amila saliha thum-mahtada) (Taha: 82). Jo bhi tauba kare aur imaan laye aur nek amal kare aur rah-e-rast par chale main us ke gunahon ko bakhshne wala hoon. Aur farman hai aayat (Wa may-ya'mal su-an au yazlim nafsahu thum-ma yastaghfirillaha yajidillaha Ghafoorar-Raheema) (An-Nisa: 110). Jo shakhs kisi burai ka murtakib ho jaye ya koi gunah kar baithe phir Allah Ta'ala se istighfar kare toh woh yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala ko Ghafoor-o-Raheem payega. Is mazmoon ki aayatein Kalam-e-Ilahi mein aur bhi bahut sari hain. Lakdi ke saanp ban jaane ke mojze ke sath hi Kaleemullah (A.S) ko aur mojza diya jata hai ke aap jab bhi apne gareban mein hath daal kar nikalein ge toh woh chand ki tarah chamakta hua nikalega. Yeh do mojze un nau mojzon mein se hain ke jin se main teri waqtan-fauqtan ta'eed karta rahunga. Taake fasiq Firaun aur us ki fasiq qoum ke dilon mein teri nabuwwat ka suboot jagah pakad jaye. Yeh nau mojze woh thay jin ka zikr aayat (Walaqad aatayna Musa tis'a aayatim bayyinatin fas-al Bani Israeela iz ja'ahum faqala lahu Firaunu inni la-azunnuka ya Musa mashoora) (Al-Isra: 101) mein hai, jis ki poori tafsir bhi is aayat ke tehat mein guzar chuki hai. Jab yeh wazeh, zahir, saaf aur khule mojze Firauniyon ko dikhaye gaye toh woh apni zid mein aa kar kehne lage yeh toh jadoo hai, lo hum apne jadugaron ko bula lete hain muqabla kar lo. Is muqable mein Allah ne haq ko ghalib kiya aur sab log zer ho gaye magar phir bhi na mane. Go dilon mein is ki haqqaniyat jam chuki thi, lekin zahir muqable se hate. Sirf zulm aur takabbur ki bina par haq ko jhutlate rahe. Ab toh dekh le ke in mufsidon ka anjam kis tarah hairat-naak aur kaisa kuch ibrat-naak hua? Ek hi martaba ek hi sath sare ke sare darya-burd kar diye gaye. Pas ae aakhri Nabi-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jhutlane walo! Tum is Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutla kar mutma'in na baitho.

Kyunke yeh toh Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bhi ashraf-o-afzal hain, un ki daleelein aur mojze bhi un ki daleelon aur mojzon se bade hain. Khud aap ka wajood, aap ke aadat-o-akhlaq aur agli kitabon ki aur agle nabiyon ki aap ki nisbat basharatein aur un se Allah ka ahd-o-paiman, yeh sab cheezein aap mein hain. Pas tumhein na maan kar nidar aur be-khauf na rehna chahiye.

Hazrat Dawood aur Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihimas Salam par khusoosi inamaat. In aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala un ne'maton ki khabar de raha hai jo us ne apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Sulaiman aur Hazrat Dawood A.S par farmayi thin ke kis tarah dono jahan ki daulat se unhein mala maal farmaya. In ne'maton ke sath hi apne shukriye ki bhi taufeeq di thi. Dono baap bete har waqt Allah ki ne'maton par us ki shukarguzari kiya karte the aur us ki tareefein bayan karte rehte the. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H ne likha hai ke jis bande ko Allah Ta'ala jo ne'matein de aur un par woh Allah ki hamd kare to us ki hamd un ne'maton se bahut afzal hai, dekho khud Kitabullah mein yeh nukta maujood hai, phir aap ne yahi aayat likh kar likha ke in dono paighambaron ko jo ne'mat di gayi thi us se afzal ne'mat kya hogi. Hazrat Dawood ke waris Hazrat Sulaiman huye, is se murad maal ki wirasat nahin balki mulk-o-nabuwwat ki wirasat hai. Agar maali meeras murad hoti to is mein sirf Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka naam na aata kyunke Hazrat Dawood ki sau biwiyan thin. Anbiya ki maal ki meeras nahin bat-ti. Chunancha Sayyid-ul-Anbiya ﷺ ka irshad hai: Hum jamaat-e-anbiya hain hamare wirse nahin bata karte, hum jo kuch chhor jayen sadqa hai. Hazrat Sulaiman Allah ki ne'matein yaad karte farmate hain yeh poora mulk aur yeh zabardast taqat ke insaan, jinn, parind sab tabe-e-farman hain, parindon ki zaban bhi samajh lete hain, yeh khaas Allah ka fazl-o-karam hai jo kisi insaan par nahin hua. Baaz jahilon ne kaha hai ke us waqt parind bhi insani zaban bolte the. Yeh mehez un ki be-ilmi hai, bhala samjho to sahi agar waqai yahi baat hoti to phir is mein Hazrat Sulaiman ki khusoosiyat hi kya thi jise aap is fakhr se bayan farmate ke hamein parindon ki zaban sikha di gayi, phir to har shakhs parind ki boli samajhta aur Hazrat Sulaiman ki khusoosiyat jaati rehti. Yeh mehez ghalat hai, parind aur haiwanat hamesha se hi aise hi rahe, un ki boliyaan bhi aisi hi rahin. Yeh khaas Allah ka fazl tha ke Hazrat Sulaiman har charind parind ki zaban samajhte the. Sath hi yeh ne'mat bhi hasil hui thi ke ek badshahat mein jin jin cheezon ki zaroorat hoti hai sab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko qudrat ne muhayya kar di thin. Yeh tha Allah ka khula ehsan aap par. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Hazrat Dawood A.S bahut hi ghairat wale the, jab aap ghar se bahar jaate to darwaze band kar jaate, phir kisi ko andar jaane ki ijazat na thi. Ek martaba aap isi tarah bahar tashreef le gaye. Thodi der baad ek biwi sahiba ki nazar uthi to dekhti hain ke ghar ke beechon beech ek sahib khade hain, hairan ho gayin aur dusron ko dikhaya. Aapas mein sab kehne lagin yeh kahan se aa gaye? Darwaze band hain yeh kahan se aa gaye? Us ne jawab diya woh jise koi rok aur darwaza rok na sake, woh kisi bade se bade ki mutlaq parwah na kare. Hazrat Dawood A.S samajh gaye aur farmane lage: Marhaba, marhaba, aap Malak-ul-Maut hain. Isi waqt Malak-ul-Maut ne aap ki rooh qabz ki.

Suraj nikal aaya aur aap par dhoop aa gayi toh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne parindon ko hukum diya ke woh Hazrat Dawood A.S par saya karein. Unhon ne apne par khol kar aisi gehri chhaon kar di ke zameen par andhera sa chha gaya, phir hukum diya ke ek ek karke apne sab paron ko sameit lo. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne poocha, Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Parindon ne phir par kaise sameite? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, apna haath sameit kar batlaya ke is tarah. Is par us din surkh rang gidh ghalib aa gaye. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka lashkar jama hua jis mein insaan, jinn, parind sab thay. Aap se qareeb insaan thay, phir jinn thay, parind aap ke saron par rehte thay. Garmiyon mein saya kar lete thay. Sab apne apne martabe par qaim thay. Jis ki jo jagah muqarrar thi woh wahin rehta. Jab in lashkaron ko lekar Hazrat Sulaiman A.S chale, ek jungle par guzar hua jahan chiyon-tiyon ka lashkar tha. Lashkar-e-Sulaiman ko dekh kar ek chiyon-ti ne doosri chiyon-tiyon se kaha ke jao apne apne surakhon mein chali jao, kahin aisa na ho ke lashkar-e-Sulaiman chalta hua tumhein rond dale aur unhein ilm bhi na ho. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain is chiyon-ti ka naam Hurmus tha, yeh Banu Sha'ban ke qabile se thi. Thi bhi langri, ba-qadr bhediye ke. Use khauf hua kahin sab rondi jayengi aur pis jayengi. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko tabassum balkay hansi aa gayi aur usi waqt Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke, "Aye Allah! Mujhe apni in ne'maton ka shukriya ada karna ilham kar jo Tu ne mujh par in'aam ki hain, maslan parindon aur haiwanon ki zaban sikha dena waghera. Neez jo ne'matein Tu ne mere walidain par in'aam ki hain ke woh musalman momin hue waghera. Aur mujhe nek amal karne ki taufeeq de jin se Tu khush hua aur jab meri maut aa jaye toh mujhe apne nek bandon aur buland rufaqa mein mila de jo Tere dost hain." Mufassireen ka qaul hai ke yeh wadi-e-Sham mein thi. Ba'az aur jagah batate hain. Yeh chiyon-ti misl makkhiyon ke par-dar thi. Aur bhi aqwal hain. Nauf Bakkali kehte hain yeh bhediye ke barabar thi. Mumkin hai asal mein lafz zubab ho yani makkhi ke barabar aur katib ki ghalti se woh ziyaab likh diya gaya ho yani bhediya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S chunke janwaron ki boliyan samajhte thay, is ki baat ko bhi samajh gaye aur be-ikhtiyar hansi aa gayi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S bin Dawood A.S istisqa (barish ki dua) ke liye nikle toh dekha ke ek chiyon-ti ulti leti hui apne paon aasman ki taraf uthaye hue dua kar rahi hai ke, "Aye Allah! Hum bhi Teri makhlooq hain, pani barasne ki mohtaji humein bhi hai. Agar pani na barsa toh hum halak ho jayenge." Yeh dua is chiyon-ti ki sun kar aap ne logon mein elaan kiya, "Laut chalo, kisi aur hi ki dua se tum pani pilaye gaye." Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain, nabiyon mein se kisi nabi ko ek chiyon-ti ne kaat liya, unhon ne chiyon-tiyon ke surakh mein aag lagane ka hukum de diya. Usi waqt Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se wahi aayi ke, "Aye Paighambar! Mehez ek chiyon-ti ke kaatne par Tu ne ek giroh ke giroh ko jo hamari tasbeeh khwan tha, halak kar diya. Tujhe badla lena tha toh usi se leta."

Sath hi yeh ne'mat bhi hasil hui thi ke ek badshahat mein jin jin cheezon ki zaroorat hoti hai sab Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko qudrat ne muhayya kar di thin. Yeh tha Allah ka khula ehsan aap par. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Hazrat Dawood A.S bahut hi ghairat wale the, jab aap ghar se bahar jaate to darwaze band kar jaate, phir kisi ko andar jaane ki ijazat na thi. Ek martaba aap isi tarah bahar tashreef le gaye. Thodi der baad ek biwi sahiba ki nazar uthi to dekhti hain ke ghar ke beechon beech ek sahib khade hain, hairan ho gayin aur dusron ko dikhaya. Aapas mein sab kehne lagin yeh kahan se aa gaye? Darwaze band hain yeh kahan se aa gaye? Us ne jawab diya woh jise koi rok aur darwaza rok na sake, woh kisi bade se bade ki mutlaq parwah na kare. Hazrat Dawood A.S samajh gaye aur farmane lage: Marhaba, marhaba, aap Malak-ul-Maut hain. Isi waqt Malak-ul-Maut ne aap ki rooh qabz ki.

Suraj nikal aaya aur aap par dhoop aa gayi toh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne parindon ko hukum diya ke woh Hazrat Dawood A.S par saya karein. Unhon ne apne par khol kar aisi gehri chhaon kar di ke zameen par andhera sa chha gaya, phir hukum diya ke ek ek karke apne sab paron ko sameit lo. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne poocha, Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Parindon ne phir par kaise sameite? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, apna haath sameit kar batlaya ke is tarah. Is par us din surkh rang gidh ghalib aa gaye. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka lashkar jama hua jis mein insaan, jinn, parind sab thay. Aap se qareeb insaan thay, phir jinn thay, parind aap ke saron par rehte thay. Garmiyon mein saya kar lete thay. Sab apne apne martabe par qaim thay. Jis ki jo jagah muqarrar thi woh wahin rehta. Jab in lashkaron ko lekar Hazrat Sulaiman A.S chale, ek jungle par guzar hua jahan chiyon-tiyon ka lashkar tha. Lashkar-e-Sulaiman ko dekh kar ek chiyon-ti ne doosri chiyon-tiyon se kaha ke jao apne apne surakhon mein chali jao, kahin aisa na ho ke lashkar-e-Sulaiman chalta hua tumhein rond dale aur unhein ilm bhi na ho. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain is chiyon-ti ka naam Hurmus tha, yeh Banu Sha'ban ke qabile se thi. Thi bhi langri, ba-qadr bhediye ke. Use khauf hua kahin sab rondi jayengi aur pis jayengi. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ko tabassum balkay hansi aa gayi aur usi waqt Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke, "Aye Allah! Mujhe apni in ne'maton ka shukriya ada karna ilham kar jo Tu ne mujh par in'aam ki hain, maslan parindon aur haiwanon ki zaban sikha dena waghera. Neez jo ne'matein Tu ne mere walidain par in'aam ki hain ke woh musalman momin hue waghera. Aur mujhe nek amal karne ki taufeeq de jin se Tu khush hua aur jab meri maut aa jaye toh mujhe apne nek bandon aur buland rufaqa mein mila de jo Tere dost hain." Mufassireen ka qaul hai ke yeh wadi-e-Sham mein thi. Ba'az aur jagah batate hain. Yeh chiyon-ti misl makkhiyon ke par-dar thi. Aur bhi aqwal hain. Nauf Bakkali kehte hain yeh bhediye ke barabar thi. Mumkin hai asal mein lafz zubab ho yani makkhi ke barabar aur katib ki ghalti se woh ziyaab likh diya gaya ho yani bhediya. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S chunke janwaron ki boliyan samajhte thay, is ki baat ko bhi samajh gaye aur be-ikhtiyar hansi aa gayi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek martaba Hazrat Sulaiman A.S bin Dawood A.S istisqa (barish ki dua) ke liye nikle toh dekha ke ek chiyon-ti ulti leti hui apne paon aasman ki taraf uthaye hue dua kar rahi hai ke, "Aye Allah! Hum bhi Teri makhlooq hain, pani barasne ki mohtaji humein bhi hai. Agar pani na barsa toh hum halak ho jayenge." Yeh dua is chiyon-ti ki sun kar aap ne logon mein elaan kiya, "Laut chalo, kisi aur hi ki dua se tum pani pilaye gaye." Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain, nabiyon mein se kisi nabi ko ek chiyon-ti ne kaat liya, unhon ne chiyon-tiyon ke surakh mein aag lagane ka hukum de diya. Usi waqt Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se wahi aayi ke, "Aye Paighambar! Mehez ek chiyon-ti ke kaatne par Tu ne ek giroh ke giroh ko jo hamari tasbeeh khwan tha, halak kar diya. Tujhe badla lena tha toh usi se leta."

Hazrat Dawood aur Hazrat Sulaiman Alaihimas Salam par khusoosi inamaat. In aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala un ne'maton ki khabar de raha hai jo us ne apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Sulaiman aur Hazrat Dawood A.S par farmayi thin ke kis tarah dono jahan ki daulat se unhein mala maal farmaya. In ne'maton ke sath hi apne shukriye ki bhi taufeeq di thi. Dono baap bete har waqt Allah ki ne'maton par us ki shukarguzari kiya karte the aur us ki tareefein bayan karte rehte the. Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz R.H ne likha hai ke jis bande ko Allah Ta'ala jo ne'matein de aur un par woh Allah ki hamd kare to us ki hamd un ne'maton se bahut afzal hai, dekho khud Kitabullah mein yeh nukta maujood hai, phir aap ne yahi aayat likh kar likha ke in dono paighambaron ko jo ne'mat di gayi thi us se afzal ne'mat kya hogi. Hazrat Dawood ke waris Hazrat Sulaiman huye, is se murad maal ki wirasat nahin balki mulk-o-nabuwwat ki wirasat hai. Agar maali meeras murad hoti to is mein sirf Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ka naam na aata kyunke Hazrat Dawood ki sau biwiyan thin. Anbiya ki maal ki meeras nahin bat-ti. Chunancha Sayyid-ul-Anbiya ﷺ ka irshad hai: Hum jamaat-e-anbiya hain hamare wirse nahin bata karte, hum jo kuch chhor jayen sadqa hai. Hazrat Sulaiman Allah ki ne'matein yaad karte farmate hain yeh poora mulk aur yeh zabardast taqat ke insaan, jinn, parind sab tabe-e-farman hain, parindon ki zaban bhi samajh lete hain, yeh khaas Allah ka fazl-o-karam hai jo kisi insaan par nahin hua. Baaz jahilon ne kaha hai ke us waqt parind bhi insani zaban bolte the. Hudhud, Hudhud fauj-e-Sulaiman mein muhandis ka kaam karta tha. Woh batlata tha ke paani kahan hai? Zameen ke andar ka paani usko is tarah nazar aata tha jaise ke zameen ke upar ki cheez logon ko nazar aati hai. Jab Sulaiman A.S jungle mein hote, us se daryaft farmate ke paani kahan hai? Yeh bata deta ke falan jagah hai, itna neecha hai, itna ooncha hai waghera. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S usi waqt jinnaat ko hukum dete aur kunwan khod liya jaata. Paani ki talash ka hukum diya, ittefaq se woh maujood na tha. Is par aap ne farmaya aaj Hudhud nazar nahin aata, kya parindon mein kahin woh chup gaya jo mujhe nazar na aaya? Ya waqai mein woh hazir nahin? Ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se yeh tafsir sun kar Nafi bin Azraq Khariji ne aitraz kiya tha. Yeh bakwasi har waqt Hazrat Abdullah ki baaton par beja aitraz kiya karta tha, kehne laga aaj toh tum haar gaye. Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kyun? Usne kaha aap jo yeh farmate ho ke Hudhud zameen ke tale ka paani dekh leta tha, yeh kaise sahi ho sakta hai? Ek bacha jaal bichha kar use mitti se dhak kar daana daal kar Hudhud ka shikar kar leta hai, agar woh zameen ke andar ka paani dekhta hai toh zameen ke upar ka jaal use kyun nazar nahin aata? Aap ne farmaya agar mujhe yeh khayal na hota ke tu yeh samajh jayega ke Ibn-e-Abbas R.A lajawab ho gaya toh mujhe jawab ki zaroorat na thi. Sun, jis waqt qaza aa jaati hai, aankhein andhi ho jaati hain aur aqal jaati rehti hai. Nafi lajawab ho gaya aur kaha Wallah ab main aap par aitraz na karunga. Hazrat Abdullah Barzi ek wali-e-kamil shakhs thay, peer-o-jumeraat ka roza pabandi se rakha karte thay. Assi saal ki umar thi, ek aankh se kaane thay. Sulaiman bin Zaid ne un se aankh ke jaane ka sabab daryaft kiya toh aap ne us ke batane se inkar kar diya. Yeh bhi peeche pad gaye, mahinon guzar gaye na woh batate na yeh sawal chhodte. Aakhir tang aa kar farmaya lo sun lo, mere paas Lulu Khorasani Barza mein (jo Damishq ke paas ek shehar hai) aaye aur mujh se kaha ke main unhein Barza ki wadi mein le jaaun. Main unhein wahan le gaya. Unhon ne angeethiyan nikalein, bukhoor nikale aur jalane shuru kiye yahan tak ke tamam wadi khushbu se mehakne lagi aur har taraf se saanpon ki aamad shuru ho gayi. Lekin beparwahi se baithe rahe, kisi saanp ki taraf iltifat na karte thay. Thodi der mein ek saanp aaya jo haath bhar ka tha aur uski aankhein sone ki tarah chamak rahi thin. Yeh bahut hi khush hue aur kehne lage Allah ka shukr hai hamari saal bhar mehnat thikane lagi. Unhon ne us saanp ko le kar us ki aankhon mein salai pher kar apni aankhon mein woh salai pher li. Main ne un se kaha ke meri aankhon mein bhi yeh salai pher do.

Unhon ne inkar kardiya, main ne un se minat samajat ki, ba-mushkil woh raazi hue aur meri dahni aankh mein woh salai pher di. Ab jo main dekhta hoon toh zameen mujhe ek sheeshe ki tarah maloom hone lagi, jaisi oopar ki cheezein nazar aati thin, aisi hi zameen ke andar ki cheezein bhi dekh raha tha. Unhon ne mujhe kaha chal ab aap hamare saath hi kuch door chalein, main ne manzoor karliya. Woh baatein karte hue mujhe saath liye hue chale, jab main basti se bahut door nikal gaya toh dono ne mujhe dono taraf se pakad liya aur ek ne apni ungli daal kar meri aankh nikali aur use phenk diya. Aur mujhe yunhi bandha hua wahin patakh kar dono kahin chal diye. Ittefaqan wahan se ek qafila guzra aur unhon ne mujhe is halat mein dekh kar raham khaya, qaid-o-band se mujhe azaad kardiya aur main chala aaya, yeh qissa hai meri aankh ke jaane ka. (Ibn-e-Asakir). Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke us hudhud ka naam Anbar tha, aap farmate hain agar fi-alwaqai woh ghair-hazir hai toh main use sakht saza doonga, uske par nochwa doonga aur usko phenk doonga ke keede makode kha jayein ya main use halaal kar doonga. Ya yeh ke woh apne ghair-hazir hone ki koi maqool wajah pesh karde. Itne mein hudhud aa gaya, janwaron ne use khabar di ke aaj teri khair nahin, badshah salamat ahd kar chuke hain ke woh tujhe maar daalein ge. Usne kaha yeh bayan karo ke aap ke alfaaz kya thay? Unhon ne bayan kiye toh khush ho kar kehne laga phir toh main bach jaunga. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) farmate hain uske bachao ki wajah us ka apni maa ke saath sulook tha.

Hudhud, Hudhud fauj-e-Sulaiman mein muhandis ka kaam karta tha. Woh batlata tha ke paani kahan hai? Zameen ke andar ka paani usko is tarah nazar aata tha jaise ke zameen ke upar ki cheez logon ko nazar aati hai. Jab Sulaiman A.S jungle mein hote, us se daryaft farmate ke paani kahan hai? Yeh bata deta ke falan jagah hai, itna neecha hai, itna ooncha hai waghera. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S usi waqt jinnaat ko hukum dete aur kunwan khod liya jaata. Paani ki talash ka hukum diya, ittefaq se woh maujood na tha. Is par aap ne farmaya aaj Hudhud nazar nahin aata, kya parindon mein kahin woh chup gaya jo mujhe nazar na aaya? Ya waqai mein woh hazir nahin? Ek martaba Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se yeh tafsir sun kar Nafi bin Azraq Khariji ne aitraz kiya tha. Yeh bakwasi har waqt Hazrat Abdullah ki baaton par beja aitraz kiya karta tha, kehne laga aaj toh tum haar gaye. Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya kyun? Usne kaha aap jo yeh farmate ho ke Hudhud zameen ke tale ka paani dekh leta tha, yeh kaise sahi ho sakta hai? Ek bacha jaal bichha kar use mitti se dhak kar daana daal kar Hudhud ka shikar kar leta hai, agar woh zameen ke andar ka paani dekhta hai toh zameen ke upar ka jaal use kyun nazar nahin aata? Aap ne farmaya agar mujhe yeh khayal na hota ke tu yeh samajh jayega ke Ibn-e-Abbas R.A lajawab ho gaya toh mujhe jawab ki zaroorat na thi. Hazrat Abdullah Barzi ek wali-e-kamil shakhs thay, peer-o-jumeraat ka roza pabandi se rakha karte thay. Assi saal ki umar thi, ek aankh se kaane thay. Sulaiman bin Zaid ne un se aankh ke jaane ka sabab daryaft kiya toh aap ne us ke batane se inkar kar diya. Yeh bhi peeche pad gaye, mahinon guzar gaye na woh batate na yeh sawal chhodte. Aakhir tang aa kar farmaya lo sun lo, mere paas Lulu Khorasani Barza mein (jo Damishq ke paas ek shehar hai) aaye aur mujh se kaha ke main unhein Barza ki wadi mein le jaaun. Main unhein wahan le gaya. Unhon ne angeethiyan nikalein, bukhoor nikale aur jalane shuru kiye yahan tak ke tamam wadi khushbu se mehakne lagi aur har taraf se saanpon ki aamad shuru ho gayi. Lekin beparwahi se baithe rahe, kisi saanp ki taraf iltifat na karte thay. Thodi der mein ek saanp aaya jo haath bhar ka tha aur uski aankhein sone ki tarah chamak rahi thin. Yeh bahut hi khush hue aur kehne lage Allah ka shukr hai hamari saal bhar mehnat thikane lagi. Unhon ne us saanp ko le kar us ki aankhon mein salai pher kar apni aankhon mein woh salai pher li. Main ne un se kaha ke meri aankhon mein bhi yeh salai pher do.

Unhon ne inkar kardiya, main ne un se minat samajat ki, ba-mushkil woh raazi hue aur meri dahni aankh mein woh salai pher di. Ab jo main dekhta hoon toh zameen mujhe ek sheeshe ki tarah maloom hone lagi, jaisi oopar ki cheezein nazar aati thin, aisi hi zameen ke andar ki cheezein bhi dekh raha tha. Unhon ne mujhe kaha chal ab aap hamare saath hi kuch door chalein, main ne manzoor karliya. Woh baatein karte hue mujhe saath liye hue chale, jab main basti se bahut door nikal gaya toh dono ne mujhe dono taraf se pakad liya aur ek ne apni ungli daal kar meri aankh nikali aur use phenk diya. Hudhud ki ghair haziri. Hudhud ki ghair haziri ki thodi si der guzri thi jo woh aa gaya. Usne kaha ke ae Nabi-e-Allah jis baat ki aap ko khabar bhi nahin main us ki ek nayi khabar le kar aap ke paas hazir hua hoon. Main Saba se aa raha hoon aur pukhta yaqeeni khabar laya hoon. Un ke Saba humair thay aur yeh Yaman ke badshah thay. Ek aurat un ki badshahat kar rahi hai us ka naam Balqees bint-e-Sharjeel tha yeh Saba ki malika thi. Qatada kehte hain, us ki maa jinnia aurat thi us ke qadam ka pichla hissa chaupaye ke khur jaisa tha aur riwayat mein hai us ki maa ka naam Rifaa tha. Ibn-e-Juraij kehte hain un ke baap ka naam Zi-Surkh tha aur maa ka naam Balta tha. Lakhon ka us ka lashkar tha. Us ki badshahi ek aurat ke haath mein hai us ke musheer-o-wazeer teen sau barah shakhs hain un mein se har ek ke taahat barah hazar ki jamiyat hai. Us ki zameen ka naam Marib hai yeh Sanaa se teen meel ke fasle par hai yahi qaul qareen-e-qiyas hai us ka aksar hissa mamlikat-e-Yaman hai wallahu aalam. Har qisam ka dunyawi zaroori asbaab use muhayya hai us ka nihayat hi shandaar takht hai jis par woh juloos karti hai. Sone se mandha hua hai aur jadao aur marwareed ki karigari us par hui hai. Yeh isi haath ooncha aur chalees haath choda tha. Chhe sau auratein har waqt us ki khidmat mein kamar basta rehti thin. Us ka diwan-e-khas jis mein yeh takht thay bahut bada mahal tha buland-o-bala kushaada aur farakh pukhta mazboot aur saaf jis ke mashriqi hisse mein teen sau saath taaq thay aur utne hi maghribi hisse mein. Use is sanat se banaya tha ke har din suraj ek taaq se nikalta aur usi ke muqabla ke taaq se ghuroob hota. Ahl-e-darbar subh-o-shaam us ko sajda karte. Raja parja sab aaftab parast thay Allah ka aabid un mein ek bhi na tha. Shaitan ne buraiyan unhein achi kar dikhayi thin aur un par haq ka raasta band kar rakha tha woh raah-e-raast par aate hi na thay. Raah-e-raast yeh hai ke suraj chand aur sitaron ki bajaye sirf Allah hi ki zaat ko sajde ke laiq mana jaye. Jaise farman-e-Quran hai ke raat din suraj chand sab qudrat-e-Allah ki nishaniyan hain. Tumhein suraj chand ko sajda na karna chahiye sajda sirf usi Allah ko karna chahiye jo in sab ka khaliq hai. Aayat (Alla yasjudu) ki ek qiraat (Al-aya asjudu) bhi hai. Ya ke baad ka munada mahzoof hai yani ae meri qaum khabardar sajda Allah hi ke liye karna jo aasman ki zameen ki har har posheeda cheez se bakhabar hai. Khab ki tafseer paani aur barish aur paidawar se bhi ki gayi hai. Kya ajab ke Hudhud ki jis mein yahi sifat thi yahi murad ho. Aur tumhare har makhfi aur zahir kaam ko bhi woh jaanta hai. Khuli chupi baat us par yaksan hai wahi tanha mabood-e-barhaq hai wahi Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rabb hai jis se badi koi cheez nahin. Chunke Hudhud khair ki taraf bulane wala ek Allah ki ibadat ka hukum dene wala us ke siwa ghair ke sajde se rokne wala tha isi liye us ke qatl ki mumanat kar di gayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne chaar janwaron ka qatl mana farma diya.

Cheenti, shahad ki makkhi, hudhud aur surad yani latora.

Ya ke baad ka munada mahzoof hai yani ae meri qaum khabardar sajda Allah hi ke liye karna jo aasman ki zameen ki har har posheeda cheez se bakhabar hai. Khab ki tafseer paani aur barish aur paidawar se bhi ki gayi hai. Kya ajab ke Hudhud ki jis mein yahi sifat thi yahi murad ho. Aur tumhare har makhfi aur zahir kaam ko bhi woh jaanta hai. Khuli chupi baat us par yaksan hai wahi tanha mabood-e-barhaq hai wahi Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rabb hai jis se badi koi cheez nahin. Chunke Hudhud khair ki taraf bulane wala ek Allah ki ibadat ka hukum dene wala us ke siwa ghair ke sajde se rokne wala tha isi liye us ke qatl ki mumanat kar di gayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne chaar janwaron ka qatl mana farma diya.

Cheenti, shahad ki makkhi, hudhud aur surad yani latora.

Tahqeeq shuru ho gayi. Hudhud ki khabar sunte hi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne is ki tahqeeq shuru kar di ke agar yeh sacha hai to qabil-e-maafi aur agar jhoota hai to qabil-e-saza hai. Isi se farmaya ke mera yeh khat Bilqees ko jo wahan ki farman-rawa hai de aa. Is khat ko chonch mein le kar ya par se bandhwa kar Hudhud uda. Wahan pahunch kar Bilqees ke mahal mein gaya, woh us waqt khalwat-khana mein thi. Us ne ek taaq mein se woh khat us ke samne rakha aur adab ke sath ek taraf ho gaya. Use sakht ta'ajjub maloom hua, hairat hui aur sath hi kuch khauf-o-dehshat bhi hui. Khat ko utha kar mohar tod kar khat khol kar padha, us ke mazmoon se waqif ho kar apne umara, wuzara, sardar aur ru'asa ko jama kiya aur kehne lagi ke ek ba-waqat khat mere samne dala gaya hai. Is khat ka ba-waqat hona is par is se bhi zahir ho gaya tha ke ek janwar ise lata hai, woh hoshiyari aur ehtiyat se pahunchata hai. Samne ba-adab rakh kar ek taraf ho jata hai, to jaan gayi thi ke yeh khat mukarram hai aur kisi ba-izzat shakhs ka bheja hua hai. Phir khat ka mazmoon sab ko padh kar sunaya ke yeh khat Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ka hai aur is ke shuru mein Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim likha hua hai, sath hi musalman hone aur tabe-e-farman banne ki dawat hai. Ab sab ne pehchan liya ke yeh Allah ke paighambar ka dawat-nama hai aur hum mein se kisi mein un ke muqable ki taab-o-taqat nahin. Phir khat ki balaghat, ikhtisar aur wazahat ne sab ko hairan kar diya, yeh mukhtasar si ibarat bahut si baton se siwa hai. Darya ko kooza mein band kar diya hai. Ulama-e-Kiram ka maqoola hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) se pehle kisi ne khat mein Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim nahin likhi. Ek ghareeb aur za'eef hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai, Hazrat Buraidah (R.A) farmate hain main Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath ja raha tha ke aap ne farmaya main ek aisi ayat janta hoon jo mujh se pehle Sulaiman bin Dawood (A.S) ke baad kisi nabi par nahin utri. Maine kaha huzoor woh kaunsi ayat hai? Aap ne farmaya masjid se jane se pehle hi main tujhe bata doonga. Ab aap nikalne lage, ek paon masjid se bahar rakh bhi diya, mere jee mein aaya shayad aap bhool gaye. Itne mein aap ne yahi ayat padhi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab tak yeh ayat nahin utri thi, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) dua (Bismika Allahumma) tehreer farmaya karte the. Jab yeh ayat utri aap ne Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim likhna shuru kiya. Khat ka mazmoon sirf isi qadar tha ke mere samne sarkashi na karo, mujhe majboor na karo, meri baat maan lo, takabbur se kaam na lo, muwahhid, mukhlis, muti' ban kar mere paas chali aao.

Bilqees ko khat mila. Bilqees ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ka khat unhein suna kar un se mashwara talab kiya aur kaha ke tum jaante ho jab tak tum se main mashwara na kar loon, tum maujood na ho to main chunke kisi amr ka faisla tanha nahin karti, is baare mein bhi tum se mashwara talab karti hoon, batao kya raye hai? Sab ne muttafiqa taur par jawab diya ke hamari jangi taqat bahut kuch hai aur hamari taqat musallam hai. Is taraf se to itminan hai, aage jo aap ka hukum ho, hum tabedari ke liye maujood hain. Is mein ek had tak sardaran-e-lashkar ne ladai ki taraf aur muqable ki taraf raghbat di thi, lekin Bilqees chunke samajhdar, aaqibat-andeshi thi aur Hudhud ke hathon khat ke milne ka ek khula mojiza dekh chuki thi, yeh bhi maloom kar liya tha ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki taqat ke muqable mein main aur mera lao-lashkar koi haqeeqat nahin rakhta. Agar ladai ki naubat aayi to alawa mulk ki barbadi ke main bhi salamat na reh sakungi. Is liye us ne apne wazeeron aur musheeron se kaha, badshahon ka qaida hai ke jab woh kisi mulk ko fatah karte hain to use barbad kar dete hain, ujaad dete hain. Wahan ke zi-izzat logon ko zaleel kar dete hain. Sardaran-e-lashkar aur hukmran-e-shehar khusoosi taur par un ki nigahon mein chadh jaate hain. Janab-e-Bari ne is ki tasdeeq farmayi ke filwaqay yeh sahi hai, woh aisa hi kiya karte the. Is ke baad us ne jo tarkeeb sochi ke ek chaal chale aur Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) se muwafiqat kar le, sulah kar le, woh us ne un ke samne pesh ki. Kaha ke is waqt to main ek garan-baha tohfa unhein bhejti hoon, dekhti hoon is ke baad woh mere qasidon se kya farmate hain. Bahut mumkin hai ke woh ise qabool farma lein aur hum aayinda bhi unhein yeh raqam bator-e-jizye ke bhejte rahein aur unhein hum par chadhai karne ki zaroorat na pade. Islam ki qabooliyat mein isi tarah us ne hadiye bhejne mein nihayat danai se kaam liya. Woh jaanti thi ke rupiya paisa woh cheez hai jo faulad ko bhi narm kar deta hai. Neez use yeh bhi aazmana tha ke dekhein woh hamare is maal ko qabool karte hain ya nahin? Agar qabool kar liya to samajh lo ke woh ek badshah hain, phir un se muqabla karne mein koi harj nahin aur agar wapas kar diya to un ki nabuwat mein koi shak nahin, phir muqabla sarasar be-sood balkay muzir hai.

Is mein ek had tak sardaran-e-lashkar ne ladai ki taraf aur muqable ki taraf raghbat di thi, lekin Bilqees chunke samajhdar, aaqibat-andeshi thi aur Hudhud ke hathon khat ke milne ka ek khula mojiza dekh chuki thi, yeh bhi maloom kar liya tha ke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki taqat ke muqable mein main aur mera lao-lashkar koi haqeeqat nahin rakhta. Agar ladai ki naubat aayi to alawa mulk ki barbadi ke main bhi salamat na reh sakungi. Is liye us ne apne wazeeron aur musheeron se kaha, badshahon ka qaida hai ke jab woh kisi mulk ko fatah karte hain to use barbad kar dete hain, ujaad dete hain. Wahan ke zi-izzat logon ko zaleel kar dete hain. Sardaran-e-lashkar aur hukmran-e-shehar khusoosi taur par un ki nigahon mein chadh jaate hain. Janab-e-Bari ne is ki tasdeeq farmayi ke filwaqay yeh sahi hai, woh aisa hi kiya karte the. Is ke baad us ne jo tarkeeb sochi ke ek chaal chale aur Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) se muwafiqat kar le, sulah kar le, woh us ne un ke samne pesh ki. Kaha ke is waqt to main ek garan-baha tohfa unhein bhejti hoon, dekhti hoon is ke baad woh mere qasidon se kya farmate hain. Bahut mumkin hai ke woh ise qabool farma lein aur hum aayinda bhi unhein yeh raqam bator-e-jizye ke bhejte rahein aur unhein hum par chadhai karne ki zaroorat na pade. Islam ki qabooliyat mein isi tarah us ne hadiye bhejne mein nihayat danai se kaam liya. Woh jaanti thi ke rupiya paisa woh cheez hai jo faulad ko bhi narm kar deta hai. Neez use yeh bhi aazmana tha ke dekhein woh hamare is maal ko qabool karte hain ya nahin? Agar qabool kar liya to samajh lo ke woh ek badshah hain, phir un se muqabla karne mein koi harj nahin aur agar wapas kar diya to un ki nabuwat mein koi shak nahin, phir muqabla sarasar be-sood balkay muzir hai.

Bilqis ne bahut hi garan-qadr tohfa Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas bheja. Sona, moti, jawaher waghera, sone ki kaseer miqdar, eentein, sone ke bartan waghera. Baaz ke mutabiq kuch bache aurton ke libas mein aur kuch aurtein ladkon ke libas mein bhejein aur kaha ke agar woh inhe pehchan lein to use Nabi maan lena chahiye. Jab yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pahunche to Aap ne sab ko wazu karne ka hukum diya. Ladkiyon ne bartan se pani baha kar apne hath dhoye aur ladkon ne bartan mein hi hath daal kar pani liya. Is se Aap ne dono ko alag-alag pehchan kar alaihda kar diya ke yeh ladkiyan hain aur yeh ladke hain. Baaz kehte hain is tarah pehchana ke ladkiyon ne to pehle apne hath ke androoni hisse ko dhoya aur ladkon ne unke bar-khilaf bairooni hisse ko pehle dhoya. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke un mein se ek jamaat ne is ke bar-khilaf hath ki ungliyon se shuru kar ke kehni tak le gaye. In mein se kisi mein nafi ka imkan nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke Bilqis ne ek bartan bheja tha, kaha ise aise pani se pur kar do jo na zameen ka ho na aasman ka, to Aap ne ghode dodaye aur un ke paseeno se woh bartan bhar diya. Usne kuch khur-mohre aur ek ladi bheji thi, Aap ne unhein ladi mein piro diya. Yeh sab aqwal umooman Bani Israel ki riwayaton se liye jate hain. Wallahu A'lam. Albata bazahir alfaz-e-Qurani se maloom hota hai ke Aap ne is rani ke tohfe ki taraf mutlaqan iltifat hi nahin kiya. Aur use dekhte hi farmaya ke kya tum mujhe maali rishwat de kar shirk par baqi rehna chahte ho? Yeh mehez namumkin hai, mujhe Rabb ne bahut kuch de rakha hai. Mulk, maal, lao-lashkar sab mere paas majood hai. Tum se har tarah behtar halat mein main hoon, Falhamdulillah. Tum hi apne is hadiye se khush raho, yeh kaam tum hi ko sonpa ke maal se raazi ho jao aur tohfa tumhein jhuka de, yahan to do hi cheezein hain ya shirk chhodo ya talwar roko. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai is se pehle ke uske qasid pahunchein, Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne jinnaat ko hukum diya aur unhon ne sone-chandi ke ek hazar mahal tayyar kar diye. Jis waqt qasid paye-takht mein pahunche, in mehalat ko dekh kar hosh jate rahe aur kehne lage yeh badshah to hamare is tohfe ko apni haqarat samjhega. Yahan to sona mitti ki waqat bhi nahin rakhta. Is se yeh sabit hua ke badshahon ko yeh jaiz hai ke bairooni logon ke liye kuch takallufat kare aur qasidon ke samne apni zeenat ka izhar kare. Phir Aap ne qasidon se farmaya ke yeh hadiye unhein ko wapas kar do aur un se keh do muqable ki tayari kar lein, yaad rakho main woh lashkar le kar chadhai karunga ke woh samne aa hi nahin sakte. Unhein hum se jang karne ki taqat hi nahin. Hum unhein unki saltanat se be-k-bini-o-dogosh zillat-o-haqarat ke sath nikal denge, un ke takht-o-taj ko rond denge. Jab qasid is tohfe ko wapas le pahunche aur shahi paigham bhi suna diya.

Bilqis ko dobara paigham-e-nabuwwat mila. Jab qasid pahunchta hai aur Bilqis ko dobara paigham-e-nabuwwat pahunchata hai toh woh samajh leti hai aur kehti hai wallah yeh sachay paighambar hain, ek paighambar ka muqabla kar ke koi panap nahin sakta. Isi waqt dobara qasid bheja ke main apni qoum ke sardaron samet hazir-e-khidmat hoti hoon taake khud aap se mil kar deeni maloomat hasil karoon aur aap se apni tashaffi kar loon. Yeh kehlwa kar yahan apna naib ek ko banaya, saltanat ke intezamat us ke supurd kiye, apna lajawab besh-qeemat jarao takht jo sonay ka tha saat mehlon mein muqaffal kiya aur apne naib ko us ki hifazat ki khaas takeed ki aur barah hazar sardar jin mein se har ek ke tehat hazaron aadmi thay, apne saath liye aur mulk-e-Sulaiman ki taraf chal di. Jinnat qadam qadam aur dam dam ki khabrein aap ko pahunchate rehte thay. Jab aap ko maloom hua ke woh qareeb pahunch chuki hai toh aap ne apne darbar mein jis mein jinn-o-ins sab majood thay farmaya, koi hai jo is ke takht ko is ke pahunchne se pehle yahan pahuncha de? Kyunke jab woh yahan aa jayengi aur Islam mein dakhil ho jayengi phir is ka maal hum par haram hoga. Yeh sun kar ek taqatwar sarkash jinn jis ka naam Kozan tha aur jo misl ek baray pahar ke tha bol para ke agar aap mujhe hukum dein toh aap darbar barkhast karein is se pehle main la deta hoon. Aap logon ke faislay karne aur jhagray chukane aur insaaf dene ko subah se dopahar tak darbar-e-aam mein tashreef rakha karte thay. Us ne kaha main is takht ke utha lane ki taqat rakhta hoon aur hoon bhi amanat-dar. Is mein koi cheez nahin churaunga. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne farmaya main chahta hoon is se bhi pehle mere paas woh pahunch jaye. Is se maloom hota hai ke Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Sulaiman bin Dawood A.S ki takht ke mangwane se arz yeh thi ke apne ek zabardast mojzay ka aur poori taqat ka suboot Bilqis ko dikhayen ke is ka takht jisay us ne saat muqaffal makanon mein rakha tha woh is ke aane se pehle darbar-e-Sulaimani mein majood hai. (Woh garz na thi jo oopar riwayat Qatada mein bayan hui). Hazrat Sulaiman ke is jaldi ke taqazay ko sun kar jis ke paas kitabi ilm tha woh bola. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke yeh Asif thay, Hazrat Sulaiman ke katib thay, un ke baap ka naam Barkhiya tha, yeh wali-e-Allah thay, Ism-e-Azam jante thay. Pakkay musalman thay, Bani Israel mein se thay. Mujahid kehte hain un ka naam Astoom tha. Baleeh bhi marwi hai, un ka laqab Zul-Noor tha. Abdullah Lahi'a ka qaul hai yeh Khizr thay lekin yeh qaul bohat hi ghareeb hai. Unhon ne kaha ke aap apni nigah doraiye jahan tak pahunchay nazar kijiye, abhi aap dekh hi rahe honge ke main isay la doonga. Pas Hazrat Sulaiman ne Yaman ki taraf jahan is ka takht tha nazar ki, udhar yeh kharay ho kar wuzu kar ke dua mein mashghool hue aur kaha dua: (Ya Zal-Jalali wal-Ikram ya farmaya Ya Ilahana wa Ilaha kulli shai-in Ilahan wahidan la ilaha illa anta i'tini bi-arshiha). Isi waqt takht-e-Bilqis samnay aa gaya.

Itni zara si der mein Yaman se Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein woh takht pahunch gaya aur lashkar-e-Sulaiman ke dekhte hue zameen mein se nikal aaya. Jab Sulaiman (A.S) ne use apne samne maujood dekh liya toh farmaya yeh sirf mere Rabb ka fazl hai ke woh mujhe aazma le ke main shukarguzari karta hoon ya nashukri? Jo shukar kare woh apna hi nafa karta hai aur jo nashukri kare woh apna nuqsan karta hai. Allah Ta'ala bandon ki bandagi se beniyaaz hai aur khud bandon se bhi uski azmat kisi ki mohtaji nahin. Jaise farman hai aayat (Man amila salihan falinafsihi al-ayah), jo nek amal karta hai woh apne liye aur jo burai karta hai woh apne liye. Aur jagah hai jo neki karte hain woh apne liye hi achhai jama karte hain. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne apni qoum se farmaya tha tum aur roo-e-zameen ke sab insaan bhi agar Allah se kufr karne lago toh Allah ka kuch nahin bigaroge. Woh Ghani hai aur Hameed hai. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ae mere bando agar tumhare sab agle pichle insaan jinnaat behtar se behtar aur nek bakht se nek bakht ho jayen toh mera mulk barh nahin jayega aur agar sab ke sab badbakht aur bure ban jayen toh mera mulk ghat nahin jayega yeh toh sirf tumhare aamal hain jo jama honge aur tum ko hi milenge jo bhalai paye toh Allah ka shukar kare aur jo burai paye toh sirf apne nafs ko hi malamat kare.

Yeh kehlwa kar yahan apna naib ek ko banaya, saltanat ke intezamat us ke supurd kiye, apna lajawab besh-qeemat jarao takht jo sonay ka tha saat mehlon mein muqaffal kiya aur apne naib ko us ki hifazat ki khaas takeed ki aur barah hazar sardar jin mein se har ek ke tehat hazaron aadmi thay, apne saath liye aur mulk-e-Sulaiman ki taraf chal di. Jinnat qadam qadam aur dam dam ki khabrein aap ko pahunchate rehte thay. Jab aap ko maloom hua ke woh qareeb pahunch chuki hai toh aap ne apne darbar mein jis mein jinn-o-ins sab majood thay farmaya, koi hai jo is ke takht ko is ke pahunchne se pehle yahan pahuncha de? Kyunke jab woh yahan aa jayengi aur Islam mein dakhil ho jayengi phir is ka maal hum par haram hoga. Yeh sun kar ek taqatwar sarkash jinn jis ka naam Kozan tha aur jo misl ek baray pahar ke tha bol para ke agar aap mujhe hukum dein toh aap darbar barkhast karein is se pehle main la deta hoon. Aap logon ke faislay karne aur jhagray chukane aur insaaf dene ko subah se dopahar tak darbar-e-aam mein tashreef rakha karte thay. Us ne kaha main is takht ke utha lane ki taqat rakhta hoon aur hoon bhi amanat-dar. Is mein koi cheez nahin churaunga. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne farmaya main chahta hoon is se bhi pehle mere paas woh pahunch jaye. Is se maloom hota hai ke Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Sulaiman bin Dawood A.S ki takht ke mangwane se arz yeh thi ke apne ek zabardast mojzay ka aur poori taqat ka suboot Bilqis ko dikhayen ke is ka takht jisay us ne saat muqaffal makanon mein rakha tha woh is ke aane se pehle darbar-e-Sulaimani mein majood hai. (Woh garz na thi jo oopar riwayat Qatada mein bayan hui). Hazrat Sulaiman ke is jaldi ke taqazay ko sun kar jis ke paas kitabi ilm tha woh bola. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke yeh Asif thay, Hazrat Sulaiman ke katib thay, un ke baap ka naam Barkhiya tha, yeh wali-e-Allah thay, Ism-e-Azam jante thay. Pakkay musalman thay, Bani Israel mein se thay. Mujahid kehte hain un ka naam Astoom tha. Baleeh bhi marwi hai, un ka laqab Zul-Noor tha. Abdullah Lahi'a ka qaul hai yeh Khizr thay lekin yeh qaul bohat hi ghareeb hai. Unhon ne kaha ke aap apni nigah doraiye jahan tak pahunchay nazar kijiye, abhi aap dekh hi rahe honge ke main isay la doonga. Pas Hazrat Sulaiman ne Yaman ki taraf jahan is ka takht tha nazar ki, udhar yeh kharay ho kar wuzu kar ke dua mein mashghool hue aur kaha dua: (Ya Zal-Jalali wal-Ikram ya farmaya Ya Ilahana wa Ilaha kulli shai-in Ilahan wahidan la ilaha illa anta i'tini bi-arshiha). Isi waqt takht-e-Bilqis samnay aa gaya.

Itni zara si der mein Yaman se Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein woh takht pahunch gaya aur lashkar-e-Sulaiman ke dekhte hue zameen mein se nikal aaya. Jab Sulaiman (A.S) ne use apne samne maujood dekh liya toh farmaya yeh sirf mere Rabb ka fazl hai ke woh mujhe aazma le ke main shukarguzari karta hoon ya nashukri? Jo shukar kare woh apna hi nafa karta hai aur jo nashukri kare woh apna nuqsan karta hai. Allah Ta'ala bandon ki bandagi se beniyaaz hai aur khud bandon se bhi uski azmat kisi ki mohtaji nahin. Jaise farman hai aayat (Man amila salihan falinafsihi al-ayah), jo nek amal karta hai woh apne liye aur jo burai karta hai woh apne liye. Aur jagah hai jo neki karte hain woh apne liye hi achhai jama karte hain. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne apni qoum se farmaya tha tum aur roo-e-zameen ke sab insaan bhi agar Allah se kufr karne lago toh Allah ka kuch nahin bigaroge. Woh Ghani hai aur Hameed hai. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ae mere bando agar tumhare sab agle pichle insaan jinnaat behtar se behtar aur nek bakht se nek bakht ho jayen toh mera mulk barh nahin jayega aur agar sab ke sab badbakht aur bure ban jayen toh mera mulk ghat nahin jayega yeh toh sirf tumhare aamal hain jo jama honge aur tum ko hi milenge jo bhalai paye toh Allah ka shukar kare aur jo burai paye toh sirf apne nafs ko hi malamat kare.

Bilqis ka takht aane ke baad, is takht ke aa jaane ke baad Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne hukum diya ke is mein qadre taghayyur-o-tabaddul kar daalo. Pas kuch heere jawaahir badal diye gaye. Rang-o-roghan mein bhi tabdeeli kar di gayi, neeche aur upar se bhi kuch badal diya gaya. Kuch kami zyadati bhi kar di gayi taake Bilqis ki aazmaish karein ke woh apne takht ko pehchan leti hai ya nahin? Jab woh pahunchi to us se kaha gaya ke kya tera takht yeh hi hai? Us ne jawab diya ke hubahu isi jaisa hai. Is jawab se us ki door-beeni, aqalmandi, zeeri aur daanai zahir hai ke dono pehlu saamne rakhe, dekha ke takht bilkul mere takht jaisa hai magar bazahir is ka yahan pahunchna namumkin hai to us ne beech ki baat kahi. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne farmaya is se pehle hi hamein ilm diya gaya tha aur hum Musalman thay. Bilqis ko Allah ke siwa auron ki ibadat ne aur us ke kufr ne Tauheed-e-Allah se rok diya tha. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne Bilqis ko ghair-Allah ki ibadat se rok diya, is se pehle kaafiron mein se thay. Lekin pehle qaul ki ta'eed is se bhi ho sakti hai ke malika ne qabool-e-Islam ka elaan mahal mein daakhil hone ke baad kiya hai, jaise anqareeb bayan hoga. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ne jinnaat ke hathon ek mahal banwaya tha jo sirf sheeshe aur kaanch ka tha aur is ke neeche paani se laba-lab hauz tha, sheesha bahut hi saaf shaffaf tha. Aane wala sheeshe ka imtiyaz nahin kar sakta tha balkay use yahi maloom hota tha ke paani hi paani hai, halankeh is ke upar sheeshe ka farsh tha. Baaz logon ka bayan hai ke is sanat se gharz Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki yeh thi ke aap is se nikah karna chahte thay, lekin yeh suna tha ke is ki pindliyan bahut kharab hain aur is ke takhne chopayon ke khuron jaise hain, is ki tehqeeq ke liye aap ne aisa kiya tha. Jab woh yahan aane lagi to paani ke hauz ko dekh kar apne painche uthaye, aap ne dekh liya ke jo baat mujhe pahunchayi gayi hai ghalat hai, is ki pindliyan aur pair bilkul insaanon jaise hi hain, koi nayi baat ya bad-surati nahin hai. Chunkeh be-nikah thi pindliyon par baal bade bade thay, aap ne usture se mundwa daalne ka mashwara diya lekin us ne kaha is ki bardasht mujh se na ho sakegi. Aap ne jinnon se kaha ke koi aur cheez banao jis se yeh baal jaate rahein, pas unhon ne hartal pesh ki, yeh dawa sab se pehle Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke hukum se hi talash ki gayi. Mahal mein bulaane ki wajah yeh thi ke woh apne mulk se, apne darbar se, apni ronaq se, apne saaz-o-samaan se, apne lutf-o-aish se khud apne se badi hasti dekh le aur apna jaah-o-hasham nazron se gir jaye jis ke saath hi takabbur-o-tajabbur ka khatma bhi yaqeeni tha. Yeh jab andar aane lagi aur hauz ki had par pahunchi to use lehlata hua darya samajh kar painche uthaye. Is waqt kaha gaya ke aap ko ghalti lagi, yeh to sheesha mandha hua hai, aap isi ke upar se baghair qadam tar kiye aa sakti hain. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ke paas pahunchte hi us ke kaan mein aap ne sada-e-Tauheed daali aur sooraj parasti ki muzammat sunayi.

Is mahal ko dekhte hi is haqeeqat par nazar daalte hi darbar ke thaath dekhte hi itna toh woh samajh gayi thi ke mera mulk toh iske pasang mein bhi nahin. Neeche paani hai aur oopar sheesha hai beech mein takht-e-Sulaimani hai aur oopar se parindon ka saya hai, jinn-o-ins sab hazir hain aur tabe-e-farman. Jab usey tauheed ki dawat di gayi toh be-deeno ki tarah usne bhi zindiqana jawab diya jis se Allah ki janab mein gustakhi lazim aati thi. Usey sunte hi Sulaiman (A.S) Allah ke samne sajde mein gir pade aur aap ko dekh kar aap ka sara lashkar bhi. Ab woh bahut hi nadim ho gayi, idhar se Hazrat ne danta ke kya keh diya? Usne kaha mujhse ghalti hui. Aur usi waqt Rab ki taraf jhuk gayi aur kehne lagi, "Aye Allah! Main ne apne oopar zulm kiya, ab main Hazrat Sulaiman ke sath Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen par iman le aayi." Chunancha sache dil se musalman ho gayi.

Ibn-e-Abi Shaiba mein yahan par ek ghareeb asar Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se warid kiya hai ke aap farmate hain Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) jab takht par mutamakin hote toh us ke paas ki kursiyon par insan baithte aur us ke paas wali kursiyon par jinn baithte, phir un ke baad shayateen baithte, phir hawa us takht ko le udti aur muallaq thamadeti, phir parind aakar apne paron se saya kar lete, phir aap hawa ko hukum dete aur woh parwaz karke subh-subh mahine bhar ke faasle par pahunchadeti, isi tarah shaam ko mahine bhar ki doori tay hoti. Ek martaba isi tarah aap ja rahe the, parindon ki dekh bhaal jo ki toh hudhud ko ghayab paya, bade naraz hue aur farmaya, "Kya woh jamghate mein mujhe nazar nahin padta ya sach much ghair hazir hai? Agar waqai woh ghair hazir hai toh main usey sakht saza dunga balkeh zibah kardunga. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke woh ghair haziri ki koi maqool wajah bayan karde." Aise mauqa par aap parindon ke par nuchwa kar aap zameen par dalwadete the, keede makode kha jate the. Is ke baad thodi hi der mein khud hazir hota hai, apna Saba jana aur woh unki khabar lana bayan karta hai. Apni maloomat ki tafseel se aagah karta hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) us ki sadaqat ki aazmaish ke liye usey Malika-e-Saba ke naam ek chithi de kar usey dobara bhejte hain jis mein Malika ko hidayat hoti hai ke meri nafarmani na karo aur musalman ho kar mere paas aajao.

Is khat ko dekhte hi Malika ke dil mein khat ki aur us ke likhne wale ki izzat sama jati hai. Woh apne darbariyon se mashwara karti hai, woh apni quwwat-o-taqat, fauj ki thaath bayan karke keh dete hain ke hum taiyar hain sirf ishare ki der hai, lekin yeh bure waqt aur apne shikast ke anjam ko dekh kar is irade se baaz rehti hai. Aur dosti ka silsila is tarah shuru karti hai ke tohfe aur hadiye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke paas bhejti hai. Jise Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) wapas kardete hain aur chadhai ki dhamki dete hain. Ab yeh apne han se chalti hai, jab qareeb pahunch jati hai aur us ke lashkar ki gard ko Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) dekh lete hain tab farmate hain ke is ka takht utha lao. Ek jinn kehta hai ke behtar, main abhi lata hoon, aap yahan se uthein is se pehle hi ise dekh lijiye.

Aap ne farmaya ke is se bhi jald mumkin hai? Is par toh yeh khamosh ho gaya lekin Allah ke ilm wale ne kaha abhi ek aankh jhapakte hi. Itne mein toh dekha ke jis kursi par paon rakh kar Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) apne takht par charhte hain wahan Bilqees ka takht numaya hua. Aap ne Allah ka shukr ada kiya aur logon ko nasihat ki aur is mein kuch tabdeeli ka hukum diya. Is ke aate hi is se is takht ke babat poocha toh us ne kaha ke goya yeh wahi hai. Is ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) se do cheezein talab keen, ek toh aisa pani jo na zameen se nikla ho aur na aasman se barsa ho. Aap ki aadat thi ke jab kisi cheez ki zaroorat padti toh awwal insano se, phir jinnon se, phir shaitano se daryaft farmate. Is sawal ke jawab mein shaitano ne kaha ke yeh koi mushkil cheez nahin hai, ghode dodaiye aur un ke paseene se is ko pyala bhar dijiye. Is sawal ke poora hone ke baad is ne doosra sawal kiya ke Allah ka rang kaisa hai? Ise sun kar aap uchhal pade aur usi waqt sajde mein gir pade aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala is ne aisa sawal kiya ke main ise tujh se daryaft hi nahin kar sakta. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se jawab mila ke be-fikr ho jao main ne kifayat kar diya. Aap sajde se uthe aur farmaya tu ne kya poocha tha? Is ne kaha pani ke bare mein mera sawal tha jo aap ne poora kiya aur toh main ne kuch nahin poocha. Yeh khud aur is ka lashkar is doosre sawal hi ko bhool gaye. Aap ne lashkariyon se bhi poocha ke is ne doosra sawal kya kiya tha? Unhon ne jawab diya bajuz pani ke is ne aur koi sawal nahin kiya. Shaitano ke dil mein khayal aaya ke agar Sulaiman (A.S) ne ise pasand kar liya aur ise apni nikah mein le liya aur aulad bhi ho gayi toh yeh hum se hamesha ke liye gaye. Is liye unhon ne hauz banaya pani se pur kiya aur oopar se ballor ka farsh bana diya is sifat se ke dekhne wale ko woh maloom hi na de, woh toh pani hi samjhe. Jab Bilqees darbar mein aayi aur wahan se guzarna chaha toh pani jaan kar apne painche utha liye. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne pindliyon ke baal dekh kar napasandidagi ka izhar farmaya lekin sath hi farmaya ke ise zail karne ki koshish karo. Toh kaha gaya ke usture se moond sakte hain, aap ne farmaya is ka nishan mujhe napasand hai koi aur tarkeeb batao. Pas shaitano ne tila banaya jis ke lagate hi baal ud gaye. Pas awwal awwal baal safa tila Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke hukum se hi tayyar hua hai. Imam Ibn Abi Shaiba (R.H) ne is qisse ko naqal kar ke likha hai yeh kitna achha qissa hai lekin main kehta hoon bilkul munkar aur sakht ghareeb hai. Yeh Ata bin Saib ka wahm hai jo us ne Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke naam se bayan kar diya hai aur zyada qareen-e-qayas amr yeh hai ke yeh Bani Israel ke dafatar se liya gaya hai jo musalmanon mein Ka'ab aur Wahb ne ra'ij kar diya tha. Allah un se darguzar farmaye. Pas in qisson ka koi aitmad nahin, Banu Israel toh jiddat pasand aur jiddat taraz thay, badal lena, ghad lena, kami zyadati kar lena un ki aadat mein dakhil tha.

Allah Ta'ala ka shukr hai ke us ne hamain un ka mohtaj nahin rakha, hamain woh Kitab di aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani woh baatein pahunchayin jo nafa mein, wazahat mein, bayan mein un ki baton se aala aur arfa hain, sath hi bahut mufeed aur nihayat ehtiyat wali. Falhamdulillah. Sarh kehte hain mahal ko aur har buland imarat ko. Chunancha Firaun maloon ne bhi apne wazir Haman se yahi kaha tha, aayat (Ya Haman-ibni li sarha). Yaman ke ek khas aur buland mahal ka naam bhi Sarh tha. Is se murad har woh bina hai jo mohkam, mazboot, ustawar aur qawi ho. Yeh bina ballaur aur saaf shaffaf sheeshe se banayi gayi thi. Dumat-ul-Jandal mein ek qila hai us ka naam bhi Marid hai. Maqsad sirf itna hai ke jab is malika ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki yeh rif'at, yeh azmat, yeh shaukat, yeh saltanat dekhi aur is mein gaur-o-fikr ke sath hi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki seerat, un ki neki aur un ki dawat suni to yaqeen aa gaya ke aap Allah ke sachche Rasool hain. Isi waqt musalman ho gayi, apne agle shirk-o-kufr se tauba kar li aur deen-e-Sulaiman ki muti ban gayi. Allah ki ibadat karne lagi jo Khaliq, Malik, Mutasarrif aur Mukhtar-e-Kul hai.

Is ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) se do cheezein talab keen, ek toh aisa pani jo na zameen se nikla ho aur na aasman se barsa ho. Aap ki aadat thi ke jab kisi cheez ki zaroorat padti toh awwal insano se, phir jinnon se, phir shaitano se daryaft farmate. Is sawal ke jawab mein shaitano ne kaha ke yeh koi mushkil cheez nahin hai, ghode dodaiye aur un ke paseene se is ko pyala bhar dijiye. Is sawal ke poora hone ke baad is ne doosra sawal kiya ke Allah ka rang kaisa hai? Ise sun kar aap uchhal pade aur usi waqt sajde mein gir pade aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala is ne aisa sawal kiya ke main ise tujh se daryaft hi nahin kar sakta. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se jawab mila ke be-fikr ho jao main ne kifayat kar diya. Aap sajde se uthe aur farmaya tu ne kya poocha tha? Is ne kaha pani ke bare mein mera sawal tha jo aap ne poora kiya aur toh main ne kuch nahin poocha. Yeh khud aur is ka lashkar is doosre sawal hi ko bhool gaye. Aap ne lashkariyon se bhi poocha ke is ne doosra sawal kya kiya tha? Unhon ne jawab diya bajuz pani ke is ne aur koi sawal nahin kiya. Shaitano ke dil mein khayal aaya ke agar Sulaiman (A.S) ne ise pasand kar liya aur ise apni nikah mein le liya aur aulad bhi ho gayi toh yeh hum se hamesha ke liye gaye. Is liye unhon ne hauz banaya pani se pur kiya aur oopar se ballor ka farsh bana diya is sifat se ke dekhne wale ko woh maloom hi na de, woh toh pani hi samjhe. Jab Bilqees darbar mein aayi aur wahan se guzarna chaha toh pani jaan kar apne painche utha liye. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne pindliyon ke baal dekh kar napasandidagi ka izhar farmaya lekin sath hi farmaya ke ise zail karne ki koshish karo. Toh kaha gaya ke usture se moond sakte hain, aap ne farmaya is ka nishan mujhe napasand hai koi aur tarkeeb batao. Pas shaitano ne tila banaya jis ke lagate hi baal ud gaye. Pas awwal awwal baal safa tila Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke hukum se hi tayyar hua hai. Imam Ibn Abi Shaiba (R.H) ne is qisse ko naqal kar ke likha hai yeh kitna achha qissa hai lekin main kehta hoon bilkul munkar aur sakht ghareeb hai. Yeh Ata bin Saib ka wahm hai jo us ne Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke naam se bayan kar diya hai aur zyada qareen-e-qayas amr yeh hai ke yeh Bani Israel ke dafatar se liya gaya hai jo musalmanon mein Ka'ab aur Wahb ne ra'ij kar diya tha. Allah Ta'ala ka shukr hai ke us ne hamain un ka mohtaj nahin rakha, hamain woh Kitab di aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani woh baatein pahunchayin jo nafa mein, wazahat mein, bayan mein un ki baton se aala aur arfa hain, sath hi bahut mufeed aur nihayat ehtiyat wali. Yaman ke ek khas aur buland mahal ka naam bhi Sarh tha. Is se murad har woh bina hai jo mohkam, mazboot, ustawar aur qawi ho. Yeh bina ballaur aur saaf shaffaf sheeshe se banayi gayi thi. Maqsad sirf itna hai ke jab is malika ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki yeh rif'at, yeh azmat, yeh shaukat, yeh saltanat dekhi aur is mein gaur-o-fikr ke sath hi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki seerat, un ki neki aur un ki dawat suni to yaqeen aa gaya ke aap Allah ke sachche Rasool hain. Isi waqt musalman ho gayi, apne agle shirk-o-kufr se tauba kar li aur deen-e-Sulaiman ki muti ban gayi. Allah ki ibadat karne lagi jo Khaliq, Malik, Mutasarrif aur Mukhtar-e-Kul hai.
