Is ke baad thodi hi der mein khud hazir hota hai, apna Saba jana aur woh unki khabar lana bayan karta hai. Apni maloomat ki tafseel se aagah karta hai. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) us ki sadaqat ki aazmaish ke liye usey Malika-e-Saba ke naam ek chithi de kar usey dobara bhejte hain jis mein Malika ko hidayat hoti hai ke meri nafarmani na karo aur musalman ho kar mere paas aajao.

Is khat ko dekhte hi Malika ke dil mein khat ki aur us ke likhne wale ki izzat sama jati hai. Woh apne darbariyon se mashwara karti hai, woh apni quwwat-o-taqat, fauj ki thaath bayan karke keh dete hain ke hum taiyar hain sirf ishare ki der hai, lekin yeh bure waqt aur apne shikast ke anjam ko dekh kar is irade se baaz rehti hai. Aur dosti ka silsila is tarah shuru karti hai ke tohfe aur hadiye Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke paas bhejti hai. Jise Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) wapas kardete hain aur chadhai ki dhamki dete hain. Ab yeh apne han se chalti hai, jab qareeb pahunch jati hai aur us ke lashkar ki gard ko Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) dekh lete hain tab farmate hain ke is ka takht utha lao. Ek jinn kehta hai ke behtar, main abhi lata hoon, aap yahan se uthein is se pehle hi ise dekh lijiye.

Aap ne farmaya ke is se bhi jald mumkin hai? Is par toh yeh khamosh ho gaya lekin Allah ke ilm wale ne kaha abhi ek aankh jhapakte hi. Itne mein toh dekha ke jis kursi par paon rakh kar Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) apne takht par charhte hain wahan Bilqees ka takht numaya hua. Aap ne Allah ka shukr ada kiya aur logon ko nasihat ki aur is mein kuch tabdeeli ka hukum diya. Is ke aate hi is se is takht ke babat poocha toh us ne kaha ke goya yeh wahi hai. Is ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) se do cheezein talab keen, ek toh aisa pani jo na zameen se nikla ho aur na aasman se barsa ho. Aap ki aadat thi ke jab kisi cheez ki zaroorat padti toh awwal insano se, phir jinnon se, phir shaitano se daryaft farmate. Is sawal ke jawab mein shaitano ne kaha ke yeh koi mushkil cheez nahin hai, ghode dodaiye aur un ke paseene se is ko pyala bhar dijiye. Is sawal ke poora hone ke baad is ne doosra sawal kiya ke Allah ka rang kaisa hai? Ise sun kar aap uchhal pade aur usi waqt sajde mein gir pade aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala is ne aisa sawal kiya ke main ise tujh se daryaft hi nahin kar sakta. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se jawab mila ke be-fikr ho jao main ne kifayat kar diya. Aap sajde se uthe aur farmaya tu ne kya poocha tha? Is ne kaha pani ke bare mein mera sawal tha jo aap ne poora kiya aur toh main ne kuch nahin poocha. Yeh khud aur is ka lashkar is doosre sawal hi ko bhool gaye. Aap ne lashkariyon se bhi poocha ke is ne doosra sawal kya kiya tha? Unhon ne jawab diya bajuz pani ke is ne aur koi sawal nahin kiya. Shaitano ke dil mein khayal aaya ke agar Sulaiman (A.S) ne ise pasand kar liya aur ise apni nikah mein le liya aur aulad bhi ho gayi toh yeh hum se hamesha ke liye gaye. Is liye unhon ne hauz banaya pani se pur kiya aur oopar se ballor ka farsh bana diya is sifat se ke dekhne wale ko woh maloom hi na de, woh toh pani hi samjhe. Jab Bilqees darbar mein aayi aur wahan se guzarna chaha toh pani jaan kar apne painche utha liye. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne pindliyon ke baal dekh kar napasandidagi ka izhar farmaya lekin sath hi farmaya ke ise zail karne ki koshish karo. Toh kaha gaya ke usture se moond sakte hain, aap ne farmaya is ka nishan mujhe napasand hai koi aur tarkeeb batao. Pas shaitano ne tila banaya jis ke lagate hi baal ud gaye. Pas awwal awwal baal safa tila Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke hukum se hi tayyar hua hai. Imam Ibn Abi Shaiba (R.H) ne is qisse ko naqal kar ke likha hai yeh kitna achha qissa hai lekin main kehta hoon bilkul munkar aur sakht ghareeb hai. Yeh Ata bin Saib ka wahm hai jo us ne Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke naam se bayan kar diya hai aur zyada qareen-e-qayas amr yeh hai ke yeh Bani Israel ke dafatar se liya gaya hai jo musalmanon mein Ka'ab aur Wahb ne ra'ij kar diya tha. Allah un se darguzar farmaye. Pas in qisson ka koi aitmad nahin, Banu Israel toh jiddat pasand aur jiddat taraz thay, badal lena, ghad lena, kami zyadati kar lena un ki aadat mein dakhil tha.

Allah Ta'ala ka shukr hai ke us ne hamain un ka mohtaj nahin rakha, hamain woh Kitab di aur apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani woh baatein pahunchayin jo nafa mein, wazahat mein, bayan mein un ki baton se aala aur arfa hain, sath hi bahut mufeed aur nihayat ehtiyat wali. Falhamdulillah. Sarh kehte hain mahal ko aur har buland imarat ko. Chunancha Firaun maloon ne bhi apne wazir Haman se yahi kaha tha, aayat (Ya Haman-ibni li sarha). Yaman ke ek khas aur buland mahal ka naam bhi Sarh tha. Is se murad har woh bina hai jo mohkam, mazboot, ustawar aur qawi ho. Yeh bina ballaur aur saaf shaffaf sheeshe se banayi gayi thi. Dumat-ul-Jandal mein ek qila hai us ka naam bhi Marid hai. Maqsad sirf itna hai ke jab is malika ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki yeh rif'at, yeh azmat, yeh shaukat, yeh saltanat dekhi aur is mein gaur-o-fikr ke sath hi Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki seerat, un ki neki aur un ki dawat suni to yaqeen aa gaya ke aap Allah ke sachche Rasool hain. Isi waqt musalman ho gayi, apne agle shirk-o-kufr se tauba kar li aur deen-e-Sulaiman ki muti ban gayi. Allah ki ibadat karne lagi jo Khaliq, Malik, Mutasarrif aur Mukhtar-e-Kul hai.

Saleh A.S ki ziddi qoum. Hazrat Saleh A.S jab apni qoum Samood ke paas aaye aur Allah ki risalat ada karte hue unhein dawat-e-tauheed di to un mein do fareeq ban gaye, ek jamaat momino ki, dusra giroh kafiron ka. Yeh aapas mein guth gaye jaise aur jagah hai ke mutakabbiron ne aajizon se kaha ke kya tum Saleh ko Rasool-e-Allah maante ho? Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum khullam khulla iman la chuke hain, unhon ne kaha bas to hum aise hi khullam khulla kafir hain. Aap ne apni qoum se farmaya ke tumhein kya ho gaya, bajaye rahmat ke azab maang rahe ho? Tum istighfar karo taake nuzool-e-rahmat ho. Unhon ne jawab diya ke hamara to yaqeen hai ke hamari tamam museebaton ka baais to hai aur tere manne wale. Yehi Firauniyon ne Kaleemullah se kaha tha ke jo bhalaaiyan hamein milti hain un ke laiq to hum hain lekin jo buraiyan pahunchti hain woh sab teri aur tere sathiyon ki wajah se hain aur aayat mein hai (WA IN TUSIBHUM HASANATUN YAQULU HAZIHI MIN INDILLAHI WA IN TUSIBHUM SAYYIATUN YAQULU HAZIHI MIN INDIKA QUL KULLUN MIN INDILLAHI FAMALI HA'ULA'IL QAUMI LA YAKADUNA YAFQAHUNA HADITHA 78) (Surah (An-Nisa: 78) yani agar unhein koi bhalaai mil jaati hai to kehte hain yeh Allah ki taraf se aur agar unhein koi burai pahunch jati hai to kehte hain yeh teri janib se hai to keh de ke sab kuch Allah hi ki taraf se hai yani Allah ki qaza-o-qadar se hai. Surah Yaseen mein bhi kuffar ka apne nabiyon ko yehi kehna maujood hai aayat (QALU INNA TATAYYARNA BIKUM LA'IN LAM TANTAHU LANARJUMANNAKUM WA LAYAMASSANNAKUM MINNA AZABUN ALIM 18) (Surah (Yaseen: 18) hum to aap se badshuguni lete hain agar tum log baaz na rahe to hum tumhein sangsar kar denge aur sakht azab denge. Nabiyon ne jawab diya ke tumhari badshuguni to har waqt tumhare wajood mein maujood hai. Yahan hai ke Hazrat Saleh A.S ne jawab diya ke tumhari badshuguni to Allah ke paas hai yani wohi tumhein is ka badla de ga. Balkeh tum to fitne mein daale hue log ho, tumhein aazmaya ja raha hai ita'at se bhi aur ma'asiyat se bhi aur bawajood tumhari ma'asiyat ke tumhein dheel di ja rahi hai, yeh Allah ki taraf se mohlat hai is ke baad pakde jaoge.))

Oontni ko maar dala. Samood ke shehar mein nau fasadi shakhs thay jin ki tabiyat mein islah thi hi nahin. Yehi un ke ru'asa aur sardar thay. Inhi ke mashwaray aur hukum se oontni ko maar dala. Un ke naam yeh hain: Ra'i, Ra'am, Haram, Hareem, Daab, Sawab, Mata', Qudar bin Salif. Yeh aakhri shakhs woh hai jis ne apne haath se oontni ki kochein kaati thin. Jis ka bayan aayat (فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطٰى فَعَقَرَ 29؀) (Surah (Al-Qamar: 29) aur (اِذِ انْۢبَعَثَ اَشْقٰىهَا 12۽) (Surah (Ash-Shams: 12) mein hai. Yehi woh log thay jo dirham ke sikkay ko thoda sa katr letay thay aur usay chalatay thay. Sikkay ko kaatna bhi ek tarah fasad hai, chunancha Abu Dawood waghera mein hadith hai jis mein bila-zaroorat sikkay ko jo musalmanon mein ra'ij ho kaatna Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mana farmaya hai. Al-gharaz un ka yeh fasad bhi tha aur deegar fasad bhi bohat saaray thay.

Is napak giroh ne jama ho kar mashwara kiya ke aaj raat ko Saleh (A.S) ko aur us ke gharanay ko qatl kar daalo. Is par sab ne half uthaye aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiye. Lekin yeh log Hazrat Saleh (A.S) tak pahunchain is se pehle azab-e-Ilahi un tak pahunch gaya aur un ka satyanas kar diya. Upar se ek chattan ludhakti hui aur un sab sardaron ke sar phoot gaye, saaray hi ek saath mar gaye. Un ke hoslay bohat barh gaye thay, khusoosan jab unhon ne Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni ko qatl kiya aur dekha ke koi azab nahin aaya to ab Nabi-e-Allah (A.S) ke qatl par aamada huye. Mashwaray kiye ke chup chaap achanak usay aur us ke baal bachon aur us ke wali warison ko halak kar do aur qoum se keh do ke hamain kya khabar? Agar Saleh (A.S) Nabi hai to hamaray haath lagne ka nahin, warna usay bhi us ki oontni ke saath sula do. Is iraday se chalay, raah hi mein thay ke farishtay ne pathar se un sab ke dimagh pash pash kar diye. Un ke mashwaron mein jo aur jamaat shareek thi, unhon ne jab dekha ke unhain gaye huye arsa ho gaya aur wapas nahin aaye to yeh khabar lene chalay, dekha ke sab ke sar phatay huye hain, bhejay niklay paray hain aur sab murda hain.

Unhon ne Hazrat Saleh (A.S) par un ke qatl ki tohmat rakhi aur unhain maar daalne ke liye niklay, lekin un ki qoum hathiyar laga kar aa gayi aur kehne lagay dekho us ne tum se kaha tha ke teen din mein azab-e-Allah tum par aayega, tum yeh teen din guzarne do. Agar yeh sacha hai to is ke qatl se Allah ko aur naraz karoge aur zyada sakht azab aayenge aur agar yeh jhoota hai to phir tumharay haath se bach kar kahan jayega? Chunancha woh log chalay gaye. Fi-al-waqay un se Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne saaf farma diya tha ke tum ne Allah ki oontni ko qatl kiya hai to tum ab teen din tak mazay ura lo, phir Allah ka sacha wada ho kar rahe ga. Yeh log Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki zabani yeh sab sun kar kehne lagay yeh to itni muddat se keh raha hai, aao hum aaj hi is se farigh ho jayain. Jis pathar se oontni nikli thi usi pahari par Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki ek masjid thi jahan aap namaz parha karte thay. Unhon ne mashwara kiya ke jab woh namaz ko aaye usi waqt raah mein hi us ka kaam tamam kar do.

Jab pahari par charhne lage toh dekha ke upar se ek chattan lurhakti hui aa rahi hai, is se bachne ke liye ek ghaar mein ghus gaye. Chattan aakar ghaar ke munh mein is tarah thehar gayi ke ghaar ka munh bilkul band ho gaya. Sab ke sab halak ho gaye aur kisi ko pata bhi na chala ke kahan gaye? Unhein yahan azab aaya, wahan baqi wale wahin halak kar diye gaye, na un ki khabar unhein hui aur na un ki unhein. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) aur ba-imaan logon ka kuch bhi na bigaar sake aur apni jaanein Allah Ta'ala ke azabon mein ganwa dein. Unhon ne makr kiya aur hum ne un ki chaal-bazi ka maza unhein chakkha diya aur unhein is se zara pehle bhi mutlaq ilm na ho saka. Anjam-e-kaar un ki fareb-baziyon ka yeh hua ke sab ke sab tabah-o-barbad huye. Yeh hain un ki bastiyan jo sunsan pari hain, un ke zulm ki wajah se yeh halak ho gaye, un ke baronaq shehar tabah kar diye gaye, zi-ilm log in nishanon se ibrat hasil kar sakte hain. Hum ne imandar muttaqiyon ko baal-baal bacha liya.))

Yani aghlam bazi par daraya. Tamam qoum ki yeh halat thi ke mard mardon se aurat aurton se shahwat-rani kar liya karti thin. Saath hi itne be-haya ho gaye thay ke is paji fe'l ko posheeda karna bhi kuch zaroori nahin jante thay. Apne majmon mein wahi fe'l karte thay. Aurton ko chhor mardon ke paas aate thay is liye aap ne farmaya ke apni is jahalat se baaz aa jao tum to aise gaye guzre aur itne nadan hue ke shar'i pakeezgi ke saath hi tum se tab'i bhi jati rahi. Jaise dusri aayat mein hai (Atatunal-zukrana minal-alamin) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 165) kya tum mardon ke paas aate ho aur aurton ko jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare jor banaye hain chhortay ho? Balkay tum had se nikal jane wale log ho. Qoum ka jawab is ke siwa kuch na tha ke jab Lut aur Lut wale tumhare is fe'l se bezar hain aur na woh tumhari mante hain na tum un ki. To phir hamesha ki is behs-o-takrar ko khatam kyun nahin kar dete? Lut A.S ke gharane ko des nikala de kar un ke roz-marra ke kuchokon se nijat hasil kar lo. Jab kafiron ne pukhta irada kar liya aur is par jam gaye aur ijma ho gaya to Allah ne unhein ko halak kar diya aur apne pak bande Hazrat Lut A.S ko aur un ki ahl ko un se jo azab un par aaye un se bacha liya. Haan aap ki biwi jo qoum ke saath hi thi woh pehle se hi un halak hone walon mein likhi ja chuki thi woh yahan baqi reh gayi aur azab ke saath tabah hui kyunke yeh unhein un ke deen aur un ke tariqon mein madad deti thi un ki bad-a'maliyon ko pasand karti thi. Isi ne Hazrat Lut A.S ke mehmanon ki khabar qoum ko di thi. Lekin yeh khayal rahe ke ma'azAllah un ki is fahsh-kari mein yeh shareek na thi. Allah ke Nabi A.S ki buzurgi ke khilaf hai ke un ki biwi badkar ho. Is qoum par aasman se patthar barsaye gaye jin par un ke naam kunda thay har ek par usi ke naam patthar aaya aur ek bhi un mein se bach na saka. Zalimon se Allah ki saza door nahin. Un par hujjat-e-Rabbani qaim ho chuki thi. Unhein daraya aur dhamkaya ja chuka tha. Tabligh-e-Risalat kafi taur par ho chuki thi. Lekin unhon ne mukhalifat mein jhutlane mein aur apni be-imani par urne mein kami nahin ki. Nabi-e-Allah A.S ko takleefein pahunchayin balkay unhein nikal dene ka irada kiya us waqt is badtareen barish ne yani sang-bari ne unhein fana kar diya.)

Yani aghlam bazi par daraya. Tamam qoum ki yeh halat thi ke mard mardon se aurat aurton se shahwat-rani kar liya karti thin. Saath hi itne be-haya ho gaye thay ke is paji fe'l ko posheeda karna bhi kuch zaroori nahin jante thay. Apne majmon mein wahi fe'l karte thay. Aurton ko chhor mardon ke paas aate thay is liye aap ne farmaya ke apni is jahalat se baaz aa jao tum to aise gaye guzre aur itne nadan hue ke shar'i pakeezgi ke saath hi tum se tab'i bhi jati rahi. Jaise dusri aayat mein hai (Atatunal-zukrana minal-alamin) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 165) kya tum mardon ke paas aate ho aur aurton ko jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne tumhare jor banaye hain chhortay ho? Balkay tum had se nikal jane wale log ho. Qoum ka jawab is ke siwa kuch na tha ke jab Lut aur Lut wale tumhare is fe'l se bezar hain aur na woh tumhari mante hain na tum un ki. To phir hamesha ki is behs-o-takrar ko khatam kyun nahin kar dete? Lut A.S ke gharane ko des nikala de kar un ke roz-marra ke kuchokon se nijat hasil kar lo. Jab kafiron ne pukhta irada kar liya aur is par jam gaye aur ijma ho gaya to Allah ne unhein ko halak kar diya aur apne pak bande Hazrat Lut A.S ko aur un ki ahl ko un se jo azab un par aaye un se bacha liya. Haan aap ki biwi jo qoum ke saath hi thi woh pehle se hi un halak hone walon mein likhi ja chuki thi woh yahan baqi reh gayi aur azab ke saath tabah hui kyunke yeh unhein un ke deen aur un ke tariqon mein madad deti thi un ki bad-a'maliyon ko pasand karti thi. Isi ne Hazrat Lut A.S ke mehmanon ki khabar qoum ko di thi. Lekin yeh khayal rahe ke ma'azAllah un ki is fahsh-kari mein yeh shareek na thi. Allah ke Nabi A.S ki buzurgi ke khilaf hai ke un ki biwi badkar ho. Is qoum par aasman se patthar barsaye gaye jin par un ke naam kunda thay har ek par usi ke naam patthar aaya aur ek bhi un mein se bach na saka. Zalimon se Allah ki saza door nahin. Un par hujjat-e-Rabbani qaim ho chuki thi. Unhein daraya aur dhamkaya ja chuka tha. Tabligh-e-Risalat kafi taur par ho chuki thi. Lekin unhon ne mukhalifat mein jhutlane mein aur apni be-imani par urne mein kami nahin ki. Nabi-e-Allah A.S ko takleefein pahunchayin balkay unhein nikal dene ka irada kiya us waqt is badtareen barish ne yani sang-bari ne unhein fana kar diya.)

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum ho raha hai ke aap kahein ke sari tareefon ke laiq faqat Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Isi ne apne bandon ko apni beshumar ne'matein ata farma rakhi hain. Uski sifatein aali hain uske naam buland aur paak hain aur hukum hota hai ke aap Allah Ta'ala ke barguzida bandon par salam bhejein jaise Anbiya aur Rasool (A.S). Hamd-o-Salawat ka sath hi zikr aayat (Subhana Rabbika Rabbil 'Izzati 'Amma Yasifun) (Surah (As-Saffat: 180) mein bhi hai. Unke tabe'daron ke bacha lene aur mukhalifeen ke gharat kar dene ki ne'mat bayan farma kar apni tareefein karne wale aur apne nek bandon par salam bhejne ka hukum diya. Iske baad bator sawal ke mushrikon ke is fe'l par inkar kiya ke woh Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke sath uski ibadat mein dusron ko shareek thahra rahe hain jin se Allah Ta'ala paak aur bari hai.)

Bayan kiya ja raha hai ke kul kainat ka kar chalane wala, sab ka paida karne wala, sab ko roziyan dene wala, sab ki hifazatein karne wala, tamam jahan ki tadbeer karne wala, sirf Allah Ta'ala hai. In buland aasmanon ko, chamakte sitaron ko usi ne paida kiya hai, is bhari bojhal zameen ko, in buland chotiyon wale paharon ko, in phaile hue maidanon ko usi ne paida kiya hai. Khetiyan, baghat, phal, phool, darya, samundar, haiwanat, jinnat, insaan, khushki aur tari ke aam jandar usi ek ke banaye hue hain. Aasmanon se pani utarne wala wahi hai. Ise apni makhlooq ko rozi dene ka zariya usi ne banaya, baghat kheti sab wahi ugata hai. Jo khush-manzar hone ke alawa bahut mufeed hain. Khush-zaiqa hone ke alawa zindagi ko qaim rakhne wale hote hain. Tum mein se ya tumhare maboodan-e-batil mein se koi bhi na kisi cheez ke paida karne ki qudrat rakhta hai na kisi darakht ugane ki. Bas wahi Khaliq-o-Raziq hai. Allah ki khaliqiyat aur us ki rozi pahunchane ki sifat ko mushrikeen bhi maante the. Jaise dusri aayat mein bayan hua hai ke aayat (وَلَىِٕنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰى يُؤْفَكُوْنَ 87؀ۙ) (43-Az-Zukhruf: 87) yani agar tu un se daryaft kare ke inhe kis ne paida kiya hai? To yahi jawab denge Allah Ta'ala ne. Al-gharaz yeh jaante aur maante hain ke Khaliq-e-Kul sirf Allah hi hai. Lekin un ki aqlein mari gayi hain ke ibadat ke waqt auron ko bhi shareek kar lete hain. Bawajood-e-ke jaante hain ke na woh paida karte hain aur na rozi dene wale. Aur is baat ka faisla to har aqalmand kar sakta hai ke ibadat ke laiq wahi hai jo Khaliq, Malik aur Raziq hai. Isi liye yahan is aayat mein bhi sawal kiya gaya ke mabood-e-barhaq ke sath koi aur bhi ibadat ke laiq hai? Kya Allah ke sath makhlooq ko paida karne mein, makhlooq ki rozi muhayya karne mein koi aur bhi shareek hai? Chunke woh mushrik Khaliq-o-Raziq sirf Allah hi ko maante the aur ibadat auron ki karte the. Is liye ek aur aayat mein farmaya. Aayat (اَفَمَنْ يَّخْلُقُ كَمَنْ لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۭ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ 17) (16-An-Nahl: 17) Khaliq aur ghair-khaliq yaksan nahin, phir tum Khaliq aur makhlooq ko kaise ek kar rahe ho? Yeh yaad rahe ke in aayaton mein 'Amman' jahan jahan hai wahan yahi ma'ani hain ke ek to woh jo in tamam kamon ko kar sake aur un par qadir ho, dusra woh jis ne in mein se na to kisi kaam ko kiya ho aur na kar sakta ho, kya yeh dono barabar ho sakte hain? Go dusri shiq ko lafzon mein bayan nahin kiya lekin tarz-e-kalam ise saaf kar deta hai. Aur aayat mein saaf saaf yeh bhi hai ke aayat (ؤ اٰۗللّٰهُ خَيْرٌ اَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ 59؀ۭ) (27-An-Naml: 59) Kya Allah behtar hai ya jinhein woh shareek karte hain?

Aayat ke khatmay par farmaya balkay hain balkay yeh woh log hain jo Allah ke shareek thehra rahe hain. Aayat (Amman huwa qanitun ana-al-laili sajidan wa qa-iman yahzarul akhirata wa yarju rahmata rabbihi, qul hal yastawillazina ya'lamuna wallazina la ya'lamun, innama yatadhakkaru ulul albab) (Surah (Az-Zumar: 9) bhi isi jaisi aayat hai, yani ek woh shakhs jo apne dil mein aakhirat ka dar rakh kar apne Rab ki rahmat ka umeedwar ho kar raaton ko namaz mein guzarta ho. Yani woh us jaisa nahin ho sakta jis ke a'maal aise na hon. Ek aur jagah hai aalim aur be-ilm barabar nahin. Aqalmand hi nasihat se faida uthate hain. Ek woh jis ka seena Islam ke liye khula hua ho, aur woh apne Rab ki taraf se noor-e-hidayat liye ho aur woh us jaisa nahin, jis ke dil mein Islam ki taraf se karahat ho aur sakht dil ho. Allah ne khud apni zaat ki nisbat farmaya. Allah ne aayat (Afaman huwa qa-imun 'ala kulli nafsim bima kasabat, wa ja'alu lillahi shuraka) (Surah (Ar-Ra'd: 33) yani woh jo makhlooq ki tamam harkat-o-sakanat se waqif ho, tamam ghaib ki baaton ko janta ho, us ki manind hai jo kuch bhi na janta ho? Balkay jis ki aankhein aur kaan na hon jaise tumhare yeh but hain. Farman hai aayat (Wa ja'alu lillahi shuraka, qul sammuhum, am tunabbi-unahu bima la ya'lamu fil ardi) (Surah (Ar-Ra'd: 33) yeh Allah ke shareek thehra rahe hain, in se keh zara in ke naam to mujhe batao. Pas in sab aayaton ka matlab yahi hai ke Allah ne apni sifatein bayan farmayi hain. Phir khabar di hai ke yeh sifaat kisi mein nahin.)))

Kainat ke mazahir Allah Ta'ala ki sadaqat. Zameen ko Allah Ta'ala ne thehri hui aur sakin banaya taake duniya aaram se apni zindagi basar karsake aur is phaile hue farsh par rahat paasake. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Alladzi ja'ala lakumul arda qarara al-ayah), Allah Ta'ala ne zameen ko tumhare liye thehri hui sakin banaya aur aasman ko chhat banaya. Is ne zameen par paani ke darya baha diye jo idhar udhar behte rehte hain aur mulk mulk pahunch kar zameen ko sairab karte hain taake zameen se khet baagh waghera ugein. Is ne zameen ki mazbooti ke liye is par pahadon ki meikhein gaarh dein taake woh tumhein mutazalzal na karsake thehri rahe. Iski qudrat dekho ke ek khaari samundar hai aur dusra meetha hai. Dono beh rahe hain beech mein koi rok aar parda hijab nahin lekin qudrat ne ek ko ek se alag kar rakha hai aur na kadwa meethe mein mil sake na meetha kadwe mein. Khaari apne fawaid pahunchata rahe meetha apne fawaid deta rahe is ka nuthra hua khush zaiqa masroor kun khush hazm paani log piyein apne janwaron ko pilayein khetiyan baariyan baghaat waghera mein yeh paani pahunchayein nahayein dhoayein waghera. Khaari paani apne fawaid se logon ko sood mand kare yeh har taraf se ghere hue hai taake hawa kharab na ho. Aur is aayat mein bhi hai in dono ka bayan majood hai aayat (Wa huwalladzi marajal bahraini hadza 'azbun furatun wa hadza milhun ujaj) (Al-Furqan: 53) yani in dono samundaron ka jaari karne wala Allah hi hai aur isi liye in dono ke darmiyan had-e-fasil qaim kar rakhi hai. Yahan yeh qudratein apni jata kar. Phir sawal karta hai ke kya Allah ke sath koi aur bhi aisa hai jis ne yeh kaam kiye hon ya karsakta ho? Taake woh bhi laiq-e-ibadat samjha jaye. Aksar log mehez be-ilmi se ghair-Allah ki ibadat karte hain. Ibadaton ke laiq sirf wahi ek hai.

Sakhtiyon aur museebaton ke waqt pukare jaane ke qabil usi ki zaat hai. Bekas bebas logon ka sahara wahi hai, gire pade bhoole bhatke museebat zada usi ko pukarte hain. Usi ki taraf lau lagate hain jaise farmaya ke tumhein jab samundar ke toofan zindagi se mayoos kardete hain to tum usi ko pukarte ho, uski taraf girya-o-zari karte ho aur sab ko bhool jaate ho. Usi ki zaat aisi hai ke har ek beqarar wahan panah le sakta hai, museebat zada logon ki museebat us ke siwa koi bhi door nahin karsakta. Ek shakhs ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Huzoor! Aap kis cheez ki taraf hamein bula rahe hain? Aap ne farmaya Allah ki taraf jo akela hai, jis ka koi shareek nahin, jo us waqt tere kaam aata hai jab tu kisi bhanwar mein phansa hua ho. Wahi hai ke jab tu jangalon mein raah bhool kar use pukare to woh teri rehnumai karde, tera koi kho gaya ho aur tu us se iltija kare to woh use tujh ko mila de. Qahat saali ho gayi ho aur tu us se duayein kare to woh musla dhaar meena tujh par barsa de. Us shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah! Mujhe kuch nasihat kijiye. Aap ne farmaya kisi ko bura na kaho. Neki ke kisi kaam ko halka aur be-waqat na samjho. Khwah apne musalman bhai se ba-kushada peshani milna ho, go apne dol se kisi pyase ko ek ghoont paani ka dena hi ho aur apne tehband ko aadhi pindli tak rakh. Lambai mein zyada takhne tak. Is se neeche latkane se bachta reh. Is liye ke yeh fakhr-o-ghuroor hai jise Allah na-pasand karta hai (Musnad Ahmad). Ek riwayat mein unka naam Jabir bin Saleem hai. Is mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas aaya, Aap ek chadar se got lagaye baithe the jis ke phandne Aap ke qadmon par gir rahe the, main ne aakar poocha ke tum mein Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) kaun hain? Aap ne apne haath se khud apni taraf ishara kiya, main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah! Main ek gaon ka rehne wala aadmi hoon, adab tameez kuch nahin jaanta, mujhe ahkam-e-Islam ki taleem dijiye. Aap ne farmaya ke kisi chhoti si neki ko bhi haqeer na samajh, khwah apne musalman bhai se khush khulqi ke saath mulaqat ho. Aur apne dol mein se kisi paani maangne wale ke bartan mein zara sa paani daal dena hi ho. Agar koi teri kisi sharmnak baat ko jaanta ho aur woh tujhe sharminda kare to tu use us ki kisi aisi baat ki aar na dila taake ajr tujhe mile aur woh gunahgar ban jaaye. Takhne se neeche kapda latkane se parhez kar kyunke yeh takabbur hai aur takabbur Allah ko pasand nahin aur kisi ko bhi hargiz gaali na dena. Hazrat Tawoos ek beemar ki beemar pursi ke liye gaye, us ne kaha mere liye dua karo, Aap ne farmaya tum khud apne liye dua karo, beqarar ki be-qarari ke waqt ki dua Allah qabool farmata hai. Hazrat Wahab farmate hain main ne agli aasmani kitab mein padha ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai mujhe meri izzat ki qasam! Jo shakhs mujh par aitmad kare aur mujhe thaam le to main use uske mukhalifeen se bacha loonga aur zaroor bacha loonga chahe aasman-o-zameen-o-kul makhlooq us ki mukhalifat aur eeza dene par tule hon.

Aur jo mujh par aitimaad na kare meri panah mein na aaye toh main usey maan-o-amaan se chalta phirta hone ke bawajood agar chahunga toh zameen mein dhansa dunga. Aur uski koi madad na karunga. Ek bahut hi ajeeb waqia Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir R.H ne apni kitab mein naqal kiya hai. Ek sahib farmate hain ke main ek khachar par logon ko Damishq se Zaidani le jaya karta tha aur isi kiraya par meri guzar basar thi. Ek martaba ek shakhs ne khachar mujh se kiraya par liya. Main ne usey sawar kiya aur chala, ek jagah jahan do raaste thay jab wahan pahunche toh us ne kaha is raah par chalo. Main ne kaha main is se waqif nahin hoon, seedhi raah yahi hai. Us ne kaha nahin main poori tarah waqif hoon, yeh bahut nazdeek raasta hai. Main us ke kehne par isi raah par chala, thodi der ke baad main ne dekha ke ek laq-o-daq bayaban mein hum pahunch gaye hain jahan koi raasta nazar nahin aata. Nihayat khatarnak jungle hai, har taraf lashein padi hui hain. Main seham gaya. Woh mujh se kehne laga zara lagaam thaam lo mujhe yahan utarna hai, main ne lagaam thaam li, woh utra aur apna tehband ooncha karke kapde theek karke chhuri nikal kar mujh par hamla kiya. Main wahan se sarpat bhaga lekin us ne mera ta'aqub kiya aur mujhe pakad liya, main usey qasmein dene laga lekin us ne khayal bhi na kiya. Main ne kaha achha yeh khachar aur kul saaman jo mere paas hai tu le le aur mujhe chhod de, us ne kaha yeh toh mera ho hi chuka lekin main tujhe zinda nahin chhodna chahta. Main ne usey Allah ka khauf dilaya, aakhirat ke azabon ka zikr kiya lekin is cheez ne bhi us par koi asar na kiya aur woh mere qatl par tula raha. Ab main mayoos ho gaya aur marne ke liye taiyaar ho gaya. Aur us se minat samajat ki ke tum mujhe do rakat namaz ada kar lene do. Us ne kaha achha jaldi padh le. Main ne namaz shuru ki lekin Allah ki qasam meri zabaan se Quran ka ek harf nahin nikalta tha. Yunhi haath bandhe dehshat zada khada tha aur woh jaldi macha raha tha, isi waqt ittefaq se yeh aayat meri zabaan par aa gayi aayat (اَمَّنْ يُّجِيْبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ اِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوْۗءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَـفَاۗءَ الْاَرْضِ 62ۭ) (Surah (An-Naml: 62) yani Allah hi hai jo be-qarar ki be-qarari ke waqt ki dua ko sunta aur qabool karta hai aur be-basi, be-kasi ko, sakhti aur museebat ko door kar deta hai. Pas is aayat ka zabaan se jaari hona tha jo main ne dekha ke beechon beech jungle mein se ek ghudsawar tezi se apna ghoda bhagaye neza taane hamari taraf chala aa raha hai aur baghair kuch kahe us daaku ke pet mein us ne apna neza ghonp diya jo us ke jigar ke aar-paar ho gaya aur woh isi waqt be-jaan ho kar gir pada. Sawar ne baag modi aur jaana chaha lekin main us ke qadmon se lipat gaya aur ba-ilhah kehne laga Allah ke liye yeh batao tum kaun ho? Us ne kaha main us ka bheja hua hoon jo majbooron, be-kason aur be-bason ki dua qabool farmata hai aur museebat aur aafat ko taal deta hai. Main ne Allah ka shukr kiya aur apna saaman aur khachar le kar sahih salamat wapas lauta.

Is qisam ka ek waqia aur bhi hai ke musalmanon ke ek lashkar ne ek jang mein kafiron se shikast uthai aur wapas loute. In mein ek musalman jo bade sakhi aur nek thay unka ghoda jo bahut tez raftar tha raaste mein ad gaya. Is wali-e-Allah ne bahut koshish ki lekin janwar ne qadam hi na uthaya. Aakhir aajiz aakar usne kaha kya baat hai jo ad gaya? Aise hi mauqa ke liye toh main ne teri khidmat ki thi aur tujhe pyar se pala tha. Ghode ko Allah ne zaban di usne jawab diya ke wajah yeh hai ke aap mera ghaas dana sa'is ko sonp dete thay aur woh is mein se chura leta tha mujhe bahut kam khane ko milta tha aur mujh par zulm karta tha. Allah ke nek bande ne kaha ab se main tujhe apni god hi mein khilaya karunga, janwar yeh sunte hi tezi se lapka aur unhein jaye-e-aman tak pahuncha diya. Hasb-e-waada ab se yeh buzurg apne is janwar ko apni god mein hi khilaya karta tha. Logon ne un se is ki wajah poochhi unhon ne kisi se waqia keh diya jis ki aam shohrat ho gayi aur log un se yeh waqia sunne ke liye door door se aane lage. Shah-e-Rum ko jab is ki khabar mili toh unhon ne chaha kisi tarah in ko apne shehar mein bula le. Bahut koshish ki magar besood rahein. Aakhir mein unhon ne ek shakhs bheja ke kisi tarah heelay bahane karke in ko badshah tak pahuncha de. Yeh shakhs pehle musalman tha phir murtad ho gaya tha badshah ke paas se yahan aaya in se mila apna Islam zahir kiya aur nihayat nek ban kar rehne laga yahan tak ke is wali ko is par poora aitmad ho gaya aur ise saleh aur deendar samajh kar is se dosti kar li aur saath saath lekar phirne lage. Is ne apna poora rasookh jamakar apni zahiri deendari ke fareb mein inhein phansa kar badshah ko ittila di ke falan waqt darya ke kinare ek mazboot jari shakhs ko bhejo main inhein wahan lekar aa jaunga aur is shakhs ki madad se isko giraftar kar lunga. Yahan se inhein fareb de kar chala aur wahan pahunchaya daf'atan ek shakhs namoodar hua aur us ne buzurg par hamla kiya udhar se is murtad ne hamla kiya, is nek dil shakhs ne us waqt aasman ki taraf nigahain uthain aur dua ki ke Aye Allah! Is shakhs ne tere naam se mujhe dhoka diya hai main tujh se iltija karta hoon ke tu jis tarah chahe mujhe in donon se bacha le. Wahin jangal se do darinday dhaadte hue aate dikhai diye aur in donon shakhson ko unhon ne daboch liya aur tukde tukde karke chal diye aur yeh Allah ka banda wahan se sahih-o-salim wapas tashreef le aaya (Rahimahullah). Apni is shaan-e-rahmat ko bayan farma kar phir janab-e-bari ki taraf irshad hota hai ke wohi tumhein zameen ka janasheen banata hai. Ek ek ke peeche aa raha hai aur musalsal silsila chala ja raha hai. Jaise farman-e-ayat (In yasha' yudhhibkum ayyuhan-nasu wa ya'ti bi-akharin) (Surah (An-Nisa: 133) agar woh chahe toh tum sab ko toh yahan se fana karde aur kisi aur hi ko tumhara janasheen bana de jaise ke khud tumhein dusron ka khalifa bana diya hai.

Aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa huwal-lazi ja'alakum khala'ifal-ardi wa rafa'a ba'dakum fawqa ba'din darajatin liyabluwakum fi ma atakum) (Surah (Al-An'am: 165). Is Allah ne tumhein zameeno ka ja-nasheen banaya hai aur tum mein se ek ko ek par darjon mein barha diya hai. Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ko bhi Khalifa kaha gaya, woh is aitbaar se ke unki aulad ek dusre ki ja-nasheen hogi, jaise ke aayat (Wa iz qala rabbuka lil-mala'ikati) (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 30) ki tafsir aur bayan guzar chuka hai. Is aayat ke is jumle se bhi yahi murad hai ke ek ke baad ek, ek zamane ke baad dusra zamana, ek qaum ke baad dusri qaum. Pas yeh Allah ki qudrat hai, usne yeh kiya ke ek mare, ek paida ho. Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ko paida kiya, unse unki nasl phailayi aur duniya mein ek aisa tariqa rakha ke duniya walon ki roziyan aur unki zindagiyan tang na hon, warna saare insaan ek saath shayad zameen mein bahut tangi se guzara karte aur ek se ek ko nuqsanat pahunchte. Pas maujooda nizam-e-Ilahi uski hikmat ka suboot hai. Sab ki paidaish ka, maut ka, aane jaane ka waqt uske nazdeek muqarrar hai. Ek ek uske ilm mein hai, uski nigah se koi ojhal nahin. Woh ek din aisa bhi lane wala hai ke in sab ko ek hi maidan mein jama kare aur inke faisle kare, neki badi ka badla de. Apni qudraton ko bayan farmata hai, koi hai jo in kamon ko kar sakta ho? Aur jab nahin kar sakta to ibadat ke laiq bhi nahin ho sakta. Aisi saaf daleelein bhi bahut kam sochi jaati hain aur unse nasihat bhi bahut kam log hasil karte hain.))))

Sitaron ke fawaid: Aasman-o-zameen mein Allah Ta'ala ne aisi nishaniyan rakh di hain ke khushki aur tari mein jo raah bhool jaye woh inhe dekh kar raah-e-rast ikhtiyar karle. Jaise farmaya hai ke sitaron se log raah paate hain, samundaron mein, khushki mein inhe dekh kar apna rasta theek kar lete hain. Badal pani bhare barsein, is se pehle thandi aur bheeni bheeni hawayein chalata hai, jis se log samajh jaate hain ke ab Rabb ki rahmat barsegi. Allah ke siwa in kamon ka karne wala koi nahin, na koi in par qadir hai. Tamam shareekon se woh alag hai, paak hai, sab se buland hai.

Qudrat-e-Kamilah ka suboot: Farman hai ke Allah woh hai jo apni Qudrat-e-Kamilah se makhlooqat ko be-namoona paida karta hai. Phir unhein fana karke dobara paida karega. Jab tum use pehli dafa paida karne par qadir maan rahe ho toh dobara ki paidaish jo uske liye bahut hi aasaan hai us par qadir kyun nahin maante? Aasman se barish barsana aur zameen se anaaj ugana aur tumhari rozi ka saman aasman aur zameen se paida karna usi ka kaam hai. Jaise Surah Tariq mein farmaya: Pani wale aasman ki aur phootne wali zameen ki qasam. Aur aayat mein hai (Ya'lamu ma yaliju fil-ardi wa ma yakhruju minha wa ma yanzilu minas-sama'i wa ma ya'ruju fiha, wa huwar-Raheemul-Ghafoor) (Surah (Saba: 2), yani Allah khoob jaanta hai har us cheez ko jo aasman mein sama jaye aur jo zameen se bahar ug aaye. Aur jo aasman se utre aur jo us par chadhe. Pas aasman se meenh barsane wala, use zameen mein idhar udhar tak pahunchane wala aur uski wajah se tarah tarah ke phal phool, anaaj, ghaas paat ugane wala wahi hai jo tumhari aur tumhare janwaron ki roziyan hain. Yaqeenan yeh tamam cheezein sahib-e-aql ke liye Allah ki badi badi nishaniyan hain. Apni in qudraton ko aur apne in garan-baha ehsanon ko bayan farma kar farmaya ke kya Allah ke sath in kamon ka karne wala koi aur bhi hai? Jis ki ibadat ki jaye. Agar tum Allah ke siwa dusron ko mabood manne ke da'we ko daleel se sabit kar sakte ho toh woh daleel pesh karo? Lekin chunke woh mehez be-daleel hain is liye dusri aayat mein farma diya ke Allah ke sath jo dusre ko bhi pooje jis ki koi daleel bhi uske paas na ho woh yaqeenan kafir hai aur nijat se mehroom hai.)

Allah ke siwa koi ghaib-daan nahin. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum deta hai ke woh saare jahan ko maloom kara dein ke saari makhlooq aasman ki ho ya zameen ki, ghaib ke ilm se khaali hai. Bajuz Allah Ta'ala wahdahu la sharika lahu ke koi aur ghaib ka janne wala nahin. Yahan istisna-e-munqata hai, yani siwaye Allah ke koi insaan, jinn, farishta ghaib-daan nahin. Jaise farman hai, aayat (Wa 'indahu mafatihul ghaibi la ya'lamuha illa huwa - Surah (Al-An'am: 59), yani ghaib ki kunjiyan usi ke paas hain jinhein us ke siwa koi nahin janta. Aur farman hai, aayat (Innallaha 'indahu 'ilmus sa'ati - Surah (Luqman: 34), Allah hi ke paas Qayamat ka ilm hai, wahi barish barsata hai, wahi maada ke pet ke bachche se waqif hai. Koi nahin janta ke woh kal kya karega, na kisi ko yeh khabar ke woh kahan marega? 'Aleem-o-Khabeer sirf Allah hi hai. Aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein hain. Makhlooq toh yeh bhi nahin janti ke Qayamat kab aayegi. Aasmanon aur zameeno ke rehne walon mein se ek bhi waqif nahin ke Qayamat ka din kaun sa hai? Jaise farman hai, aayat (Saqulat fis samawati wal ard - Surah (Al-A'raf: 187), sab par yeh ilm mushkil hai aur bojh-hal hai, woh toh achanak aa jayegi. Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ka farman hai, jo kahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kul kainat ki baat jante the, us ne Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala par bohtan-e-'azeem bandha, is liye ke Allah farmata hai zameen-o-aasman walon mein se koi bhi ghaib ki baat janne wala nahin. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain, Allah Ta'ala ne sitaron mein teen faide rakhe hain: aasman ki zeenat, bhoole bhatkon ki rehbari aur shaitanon ki maar. Kisi aur baat ka in ke sath aqeeda rakhna, apni raye se baat banana aur khud-sakhta takleef aur apni 'aqibat ke hisse ko khona hai. Jahilon ne sitaron ke sath ilm-e-nujoom ko mu'allaq rakh kar fazool baatein banayi hain ke is sitare ke waqt jo nikah kare yun hoga, falan sitare ke mauqe par safar karne se yeh hota hai, falan sitare ke waqt jo tawallud hua woh aisa, waghera waghera. Yeh sab dhakosle hain, un ki bakwas ke khilaf aksar hota rehta hai, har sitare ke waqt kala, gora, thungna, lamba, khoobsurat, bad-shakal paida hota hi rehta hai. Na koi janwar ghaib jane, na kisi parind se ghaib hasil ho sake, na sitare ghaib ki rehnumai karein. Suno, Allah ka faisla ho chuka hai ke aasman-o-zameen ki kul makhlooq ghaib se be-khabar hai. Inhein toh apne jee uthne ka waqt bhi nahin maloom hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). SubhanAllah, Hazrat Qatada (R.H) ka yeh qaul kitna sahih, kis qadar mufeed aur maloomat se pur hai. Farmata hai baat yeh hai ke woh ilm-e-aakhirat ke waqt ke janne se qasir hain, aajiz ho gaye hain. Ek qira'at mein 'bal idrak' hai, yani sab ke ilm-e-aakhirat ka sahih waqt na janne mein barabar hain. Jaise ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Jibra'eel (A.S) ke sawal ke jawab mein farmaya tha ke mera aur tera dono ka ilm is ke jawab se aajiz hai. Pas yahan bhi farmaya ke aakhirat se un ke ilm ghaib hain. Chunke kuffar apne Rabb se jahil hain, is liye aakhirat ke bhi munkir hain.

Wahan tak un ke ilm pahunchte hi nahin. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke aakhirat mein un ko ilm hasil hoga lekin besood. Jaise aur jagah bhi hain ke jis din yeh hamare paas pahunchenge bade hi dana-o-beena ho jayenge. Lekin aaj zalim khuli gumrahi mein honge. Phir farmata hai ke balkeh yeh toh shak hi mein hain is se murad kafir hai jaise farman hai aayat (Wa uridu ala Rabbika saffa) (18-Al-Kahf: 48) yani yeh log apne Rabb ke samne saf-basta pesh kiye jayenge. Allah Ta'ala farmayega hum ne jis tarah tumhein pehli martaba paida kiya tha ab hum tumhein dobara le aaye hain lekin tum toh yeh samajhte rahe ke Qayamat toh koi cheez hi nahin. Murad yeh hai ke tum mein se kafir yeh samajhte rahe. Go mandarija bala aayat bhi go zameer jins ki taraf laut-ti hai lekin murad kuffar hi hain isi liye aakhir mein farmaya ke yeh toh is se andhapay mein hain, nabina ho rahe hain, aankhein band kar rakhi hain.)))

Hayat-e-Sani ke munkir, yahan yeh bayan ho raha hai ke munkireen-e-Qayamat ki samajh mein ab tak bhi nahin aaya ke marne aur sad-gal jaane ke baad, mitti aur raakh ho jaane ke baad hum dobara kaise paida kiye jayenge? Woh is par sakht muta'ajib hain. Kehte hain muddaton se, agle zamaanon se yeh sunte chale aate hain lekin hum ne toh kisi ko marne ke baad jeeta hua dekha nahin. Suni sunayi baatein hain, unhon ne apne aglon se, unhon ne apne se pehle walon se sunin, hum tak pahunchin lekin sab aql se door hain. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ko jawab batata hai ke in se kaho zara zameen mein chal phir kar dekhein ke Rasoolon ko jhoota jaanne walon aur Qayamat ko na maanne walon ka kaisa dardnaak, hasrat-naak anjaam hua? Halaak aur tabah ho gaye aur Nabiyon aur imaan walon ko Allah Ta'ala ne bacha liya. Yeh Nabiyon ki sachayi ki daleel hai. Phir apne Nabi ko tasalli dete hain ke yeh tujhe aur mere kalaam ko jhutlate hain lekin tu in par afsos aur ranj na kar. In ke peeche apni jaan ko rog na laga. Yeh tere saath jo roobah-baziyan kar rahe hain aur jo chaalein chal rahe hain hamein khoob ilm hai, tu be-fikr reh. Tujhe aur tere deen ko hum urooj dene wale hain. Duniya jahan par tujhe hum bulandi denge.

Qayamat ke munkir mushrik chunke qayamat ke aane ke qail hi nahin. Jurrat se use jaldi talab karte the aur kehte the ke agar sache ho toh batao woh kab aayegi. Janab-e-Bari ki taraf se bawasta Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jawab mil raha hai ke mumkin hai woh bilkul hi qareeb aa gayi ho. Lakum ka laam radf ke ajal ke ma'ani ko mutazammin hone ki wajah se hai. Jaise ke Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) se marwi hai phir farmaya ke Allah ke toh insanon par bahut hi fazl-o-karam hain. Un ki beshumar ne'amatein un ke paas hain taham un mein ke aksar nashukre hain. Jis tarah tamam zahir umoor us par aashkara hain isi tarah tamam batini umoor bhi us par zahir hain. Jaise farmaya (سَوَاۗءٌ مِّنْكُمْ مَّنْ اَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ وَمَنْ جَهَرَ بِهٖ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍۢ بِالَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌۢ بِالنَّهَارِ - Sawa'un minkum man asarral qawla wa man jahara bihi wa man huwa mustakhfim bil laili wa saribum bin nahar) (Ar-Ra'd: 10), aur aayat mein hai (يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَاَخْفٰي - Ya'lamus sirra wa akhfa) (Taha: 7) aur aayat mein hai (اَلَا حِيْنَ يَسْتَغْشُوْنَ ثِيَابَھُمْ ۙ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُوْنَ ۚ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِذَات الصُّدُوْرِ - Ala heena yastaghshoona siyabahum ya'lamu ma yusirroona wa ma yu'linoona innahu aleemum bi zatis sudoor) (Hud: 5) matlab yahi hai ke har zahir-o-batin ka woh aalim hai. Phir bayan farmata hai ke har ghaib hazir ka use ilm hai woh Allam-ul-Ghuyub hai. Aasman-o-zameen ki tamam cheezein khwah tum ko un ka ilm ho ya na ho Allah ke haan khuli kitab mein likhi hui hain. Jaise farman hai ke kya tu nahin janta ke aasman-o-zameen ki har ek cheez ka Allah aalim hai. Sab kuch kitab mein majood hai Allah par sab kuch aasaan hai.

Haq-o-batil mein faisla karne wala. Quran-e-Pak ki hidayat bayan ho rahi hai, ke is mein jahan rahmat hai wahan Furqan bhi hai aur Bani Israel hamilan-e-Taurat-o-Injeel ke ikhtilafat ka faisla bhi hai. Jaise Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke bare mein Yahudiyon ne munh phat baat aur niri tuhmat rakh di thi aur Isaiyon ne unhein un ki had se aage badha diya tha. Quran ne faisla kiya aur ifrat-o-tafrit ko chhod kar haq baat bata di ke woh Allah ke bande aur Us ke Rasool hain. Woh Allah ke hukum se paida hue hain, un ki walida nihayat pakdaman thi. Sahih aur beshak-o-shuba baat yahi hai. Aur yeh Quran mominon ke dil ki hidayat hai aur un ke liye sarasar rahmat hai. Qayamat ke din un ke faisle karega jo badla lene mein ghalib hai aur bande ke aqwal-o-af'al ka aalim hai. Tujhe isi par kamil bharosa rakhna chahiye. Apne Rab ki risalat ki tabligh mein kotahi nahin karni chahiye. Tu to sarasar haq par hai, mukhalifeen shaqi-e-azali hain. Un par tere Rab ki baat sadiq aa chuki hai ke unhein iman naseeb nahin hone ka, go tu unhein tamam mojze dikha de. Tu murdon ko nafa dene wali sama'at nahin de sakta. Isi tarah yeh kuffar hain ke un ke dilon par parde hain, un ke kanon mein bojh hain. Yeh bhi qabooliyat ka sunna nahin sunenge aur na tu behron ko apni aawaz suna sakta hai jabke woh peeth mode munh phere ja rahe hon. Aur tu andhon ko un ki gumrahi mein bhi rehnumai nahin kar sakta, tu sirf unhi ko suna sakta hai, yani qabool sirf wahi karenge jo kan laga kar sunen aur dil laga kar samjhein, sath hi iman-o-Islam bhi un mein ho, Allah ke Rasool ke manne wale hon, Deen-e-Allah ke qail-o-hamil hon.

Qayamat ke din un ke faisle karega jo badla lene mein ghalib hai aur bande ke aqwal-o-af'al ka aalim hai. Tujhe isi par kamil bharosa rakhna chahiye. Apne Rab ki risalat ki tabligh mein kotahi nahin karni chahiye. Tu to sarasar haq par hai, mukhalifeen shaqi-e-azali hain. Un par tere Rab ki baat sadiq aa chuki hai ke unhein iman naseeb nahin hone ka, go tu unhein tamam mojze dikha de. Tu murdon ko nafa dene wali sama'at nahin de sakta. Isi tarah yeh kuffar hain ke un ke dilon par parde hain, un ke kanon mein bojh hain. Yeh bhi qabooliyat ka sunna nahin sunenge aur na tu behron ko apni aawaz suna sakta hai jabke woh peeth mode munh phere ja rahe hon. Aur tu andhon ko un ki gumrahi mein bhi rehnumai nahin kar sakta, tu sirf unhi ko suna sakta hai, yani qabool sirf wahi karenge jo kan laga kar sunen aur dil laga kar samjhein, sath hi iman-o-Islam bhi un mein ho, Allah ke Rasool ke manne wale hon, Deen-e-Allah ke qail-o-hamil hon.

Quran-e-Pak ki hidayat bayan ho rahi hai, ke is mein jahan rahmat hai wahan Furqan bhi hai aur Bani Israel hamilan-e-Taurat-o-Injeel ke ikhtilafat ka faisla bhi hai. Jaise Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke bare mein Yahudiyon ne munh phat baat aur niri tuhmat rakh di thi aur Isaiyon ne unhein un ki had se aage badha diya tha. Dabbat-ul-Arz jis janwar ka yahan zikr hai yeh logon ke bilkul bigar jaane aur Deen-e-Haq ko chor baithne ke waqt aakhir zamane mein zahir hoga. Jab ke logon ne Deen-e-Haq ko badal diya hoga. Baaz kehte hain yeh Makkah Sharif se nikle ga, baaz kehte hain aur kisi jagah se jis ki tafseel abhi aaye gi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Woh bole ga, baatein kare ga aur kahe ga ke log Allah ki aayaton ka yaqeen nahin karte the. Ibn-e-Jarir isi ko mukhtar kehte hain. Lekin is qaul mein nazar hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai ke woh unhein zakhmi kare ga, ek riwayat mein hai ke woh yeh aur woh dono kare ga. Yeh qaul bohat achha hai aur dono baaton mein koi tazad nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Woh ahadees jo Dabbat-ul-Arz ke bare mein marwi hain, un mein se kuch hum yahan bayan karte hain, Wallah-ul-Musta'an. Sahaba-e-Kiram ek martaba baithe Qayamat ka zikr kar rahe the. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Arafat se aaye. Hamein zikr mein mashghool dekh kar farmane lage ke Qayamat qaim na hogi jab tak tum das nishaniyan na dekh lo. Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuan, Dabbat-ul-Arz, Yajuj Majuj, Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ka zuhoor, aur Dajjal ka nikalna aur maghrib, mashriq aur Jazeerat-ul-Arab mein teen khasf hona, aur ek aag ka Adan se nikalna jo logon ka hashr kare gi. Inhi ke sath raat guzare gi aur inhi ke sath dopahar ka sona soye gi (Muslim waghera). Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke Dabbat-ul-Arz teen martaba nikle ga, door daraz ke jungle se zahir hoga aur is ka zikr shehar yani Makkah tak na pohanche ga, phir ek lambe zamane ke baad dobara zahir hoga aur logon ki zabanon par is ka qissa charh jaye ga yahan tak ke Makkah mein bhi is ki shohrat pohanch jaye gi. Phir jab log Allah ki sab se zyada hurmat-o-azmat wali masjid, Masjid-e-Haram mein honge, usi waqt achanak daf'atan Dabbat-ul-Arz unhein wahi dikhayi de ga ke Rukn-e-Maqam ke darmiyan apne sar se mitti jhaar raha hoga. Log is ko dekh kar idhar udhar hone lagen ge, yeh mominon ki jamaat ke paas jaye ga aur un ke munh ko misl-e-roshan sitare ke munawwar kar de ga, is se bhaag kar na koi bach sakta hai aur na chup sakta hai. Yahan tak ke ek shakhs is ko dekh kar namaz ko khara ho jaye ga, yeh is ko kahe ga ab namaz ko khara hua hai? Phir is ki peshani par nishan kar de ga aur chala jaye ga. Is ke in nishanat ke baad kafir-o-momin ka saaf taur par imtiyaz ho jaye ga yahan tak ke momin kafir se kahe ga ke ae kafir! Mera haq ada kar, aur kafir momin se kahe ga ae momin! Mera haq ada kar. Yeh riwayat Huzaifa bin Asid se mauqoofan bhi marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke yeh Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke zamane mein hoga jab ke aap Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf kar rahe honge lekin is ki asnad sahih nahin hai. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke sab se pehle jo nishani zahir hogi woh suraj ka maghrib se nikalna aur Dabbat-ul-Arz ka zuha ke waqt aa jana hai. In dono mein se jo pehle hoga is ke baad hi dusra hoga. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya chhe cheezon ki aamad se pehle nek aamal kar lo.

Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, dhuwein ka aana, Dajjal ka aana, aur Dabbat-ul-Arz ka aana tum mein se har ek ka khaas amr aur aam amr. Yeh hadith aur sanadon se dusri kitabon mein bhi hai. Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai ke Dabbat-ul-Arz ke saath Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki lakri aur Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki angoothi hogi. Kafiron ki naak par lakri se mohar lagaye ga aur mominon ke munh angoothi se munawwar karde ga yahan tak ke ek dastarkhwan par baithe hue momin kafir sab zahir honge. Ek aur hadith mein jo Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, marwi hai ke kafiron ke naak par angoothi se mohar kare ga aur mominon ke chehre lakri se chamka de ga. Ibn-e-Majah mein Hazrat Buraidah (R.A) se riwayat hai ke mujhe Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) le kar Makkah ke paas ek jungle mein gaye. Maine dekha ke ek khushk zameen hai jis ke gird-o-pesh ret hai. Farmane lage yahin se Dabbat-ul-Arz nikle ga. Ibn-e-Buraidah kehte hain is ke kayi saal baad mein Hajj ke liye nikla to mujhe lakri dikhayi di jo meri is lakri ke barabar thi. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is ke chaar pair honge, Safa ke khadd se nikle ga, bahut tezi se khurooj kare ga jaise ke koi tez raftar ghoda ho lekin taham teen din mein is ke jism ka teesra hissa bhi na nikla hoga. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se jab is ki babat pucha gaya to farmane lage Jiyad mein ek chattan hai is ke neeche se nikle ga, mein agar wahan hota to tumhein woh chattan dikha deta. Yeh seedha mashriq ki taraf jaye ga aur is shor se jaye ga ke har taraf is ki aawaz pahunch jaye gi. Phir Shaam ki taraf jaye ga wahan bhi cheekh laga kar, phir Yaman ki taraf mutawajja hoga yahan bhi aawaz laga kar, shaam ke waqt Makkah se chal kar subh ko Asfan pahunch jaye ga. Logon ne pucha phir kya hoga? Farmaya phir mujhe maloom nahin. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ka qaul hai ke Muzdalifah ki raat ko nikle ga. Hazrat Uzair (A.S) ke ek kalam ki hikayat hai ke Sadum ke neeche se yeh nikle ga. Is ke kalam ko sab sunenge, hamila ke hamal waqt se pehle gir jayenge, meetha pani kadwa ho jaye ga, dost dushman ho jayenge, hikmat jal jaye gi, ilm uth jaye ga, neeche ki zameen baatein kare gi, insaan ki woh tamannayein hongi ke jo kabhi puri na hon, un cheezon ki koshish hogi jo kabhi hasil na ho. Is baare mein kaam karenge jise khayenge nahin. Abu Hurairah (R.A) ka qaul hai is ke jism par sab rang honge. Is ke do seengon ke darmiyan sawar ke liye ek farsakh ki raah hogi. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) kehte hain ke yeh mote neze ki aur bhaale ki tarah ka hoga. Hazrat Ali (R.A) farmate hain is ke baal honge, khur honge, daarhi hogi, dum na hogi. Teen din mein bamushkil ek tihayi bahar aayega halankeh tez ghode ki chaal chalta hoga. Abu Zubair ka qaul hai ke is ka sar bail ke sar ke mushabah hoga, aankhein khanzeer ki aankhon ke mushabah hongi, kaan haathi jaise honge, seeng ki jagah oont ki tarah hogi, shutur-murgh jaisi gardan hogi, sher jaisa seena hoga, cheetay jaisa rang hoga, billi jaisi kamar hogi, mende jaisi dum hogi, oont jaise paon honge, har do jod ke darmiyan barah gaz ka fasla hoga.

Hazrat Musa A.S ki lakri aur Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki angoothi saath hogi. Har momin ke chehre par apne asaye-e-Mousavi se nishan karega jo phail jayega aur chehra munawwar ho jayega aur har kafir ke chehre par khatam-e-Sulaimani se nishani laga dega jo phail jayega aur uska sara chehra siyah ho jayega. Ab toh is tarah momin kafir zahir ho jayenge ke khareedo-farokht ke waqt, khane peene ke waqt log ek dusre ko 'aye momin' aur 'aye kafir' keh kar bulayenge. Dabbatul-Arz ek ek ka naam le kar unko jannat ki khushkhabri ya jahannam ki badkhabri sunayega. Yehi ma'ani-o-matlab is aayat ka hai.

Baaz purs ke lamhaat. Allah ki baaton ko na maanne walon ka Allah ke saamne hashr hoga aur wahan unhein daant-dupat hogi taake un ki zillat-o-haqarat ho. Har qoum mein se har zamane ke aise logon ke giroh alag alag pesh honge jaise farman hai aayat (Ushuru-ullazina zalamu wa azwajahum wa ma kanu ya'budun) (Surah (As-Saffat: 22) Zalimon ko aur un ke jodon ko jama karo. Aur jaise farman hai aayat (Wa izannufusu zuwwijat) (Surah (At-Takwir: 7) Jab ke nafs-on ki jodiyan milayi jayengi. Yeh sab ek dusre ko dhakke denge aur awwal wale aakhir walon ko rad karenge. Phir sab ke sab janwaron ki tarah hanka kar Allah ke saamne laye jayenge. Un ke hazir hote hi woh Muntaqim-e-Haqiqi nihayat gusse se un se baaz purs karega. Yeh nekiyon se khali haath honge jaise farmaya aayat (Fala saddaqa wa la salla) (Surah (Al-Qiyamah: 31) Ya'ni na unhon ne sachayi ki thi na namazein padhi thin balkay jhutlaya tha aur munh moda tha. Pas un par hujjat saabit ho jayegi aur koi uzr na kar sakenge. Jaise farman hai aayat (Haza yawmu la yantiqoon) (Surah (Al-Mursalat: 35) Yeh woh din hai ke bol na sakenge aur na koi maqool uzr pesh kar sakenge aur na ghair-maqool ma'zarat ki ijazat payenge. Pas un ke zimme baat saabit ho jayegi. Shashdar-o-hairan reh jayenge apne zulm ka badla khoob payenge. Duniya mein zalim thay ab jis ke saamne khade honge woh Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai koi baat banaye na banegi. Phir apni qudrat-e-kamilah ka bayan farmata hai aur apni bulandi-e-shaan batata hai aur apni azeem-ush-shaan saltanat dikhata hai jo khuli daleel hai, us ki ita'at ki farziyat par aur us ke hukumon ke baja lane aur us ke mana karda kamon se ruke rehne ki zaroorat par. Aur us ke nabiyon ko saccha manne ki asliyat par. Ke us ne raat ko pur-sukoon banaya taake tum us mein aaram hasil kar lo aur din bhar ki thakan door kar lo aur din ko roshan banaya taake tum apni ma'ash ki talash kar lo, safar, tijarat, karobar ba-aasani kar sako. Yeh tamam cheezein ek momin ke liye to kaafi se zyada daleel hain.))))

Jaise farman hai aayat (Haza yawmu la yantiqoon) (Surah (Al-Mursalat: 35) Yeh woh din hai ke bol na sakenge aur na koi maqool uzr pesh kar sakenge aur na ghair-maqool ma'zarat ki ijazat payenge. Pas un ke zimme baat saabit ho jayegi. Shashdar-o-hairan reh jayenge apne zulm ka badla khoob payenge. Duniya mein zalim thay ab jis ke saamne khade honge woh Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai koi baat banaye na banegi. Phir apni qudrat-e-kamilah ka bayan farmata hai aur apni bulandi-e-shaan batata hai aur apni azeem-ush-shaan saltanat dikhata hai jo khuli daleel hai, us ki ita'at ki farziyat par aur us ke hukumon ke baja lane aur us ke mana karda kamon se ruke rehne ki zaroorat par. Aur us ke nabiyon ko saccha manne ki asliyat par. Ke us ne raat ko pur-sukoon banaya taake tum us mein aaram hasil kar lo aur din bhar ki thakan door kar lo aur din ko roshan banaya taake tum apni ma'ash ki talash kar lo, safar, tijarat, karobar ba-aasani kar sako. Yeh tamam cheezein ek momin ke liye to kaafi se zyada daleel hain.))))

Jab Soor phoonka jaye ga, Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ki ghabrahat aur be-chaini ko bayan farma rahe hain. Soor mein Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ba-hukm-e-Ilahi phoonk maarenge. Us waqt zameen par badtareen log honge. Der tak nafkha phoonkte rahenge, jis se sab pareshan-e-haal ho jayenge siwaye shaheedon ke jo Allah ke haan zinda hain aur roziyan diye jate hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se ek din kisi shakhs ne daryaft kiya ke yeh aap kya farmaya karte hain ke itne itne waqt tak Qayamat aa jayegi? Aap ne SubhanAllah ya La ilaha illallah ya aur koi aisa hi kalma bator-e-ta'ajjub kaha aur farmane lage suno! Ab to jee chahta hai ke kisi se koi hadith bayan hi na karoon, main ne yeh kaha tha ke anqareeb tum badi ahem baatein dekhoge. Baitullah kharab ho jayega aur yeh hoga woh hoga waghera. Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ka farman hai ke Dajjal meri ummat mein chalees (40) thehre ga. Main nahin janta ke chalees din ya chalees mahine ya chalees saal. Phir Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko nazil farmayenge. Woh surat-e-shakal mein bilkul Hazrat Urwah bin Mas'ood (R.A) jaise honge, aap use dhoond nikalenge aur use halak kar denge. Phir saat saal aise guzrenge ke duniya bhar mein do shakhs aise na honge jin mein aapas mein bughz-o-adawat ho. Phir Allah Ta'ala Shaam ki taraf se ek bheeni bheeni thandi hawa chalayega jis se har momin faut ho jayega. Ek zarre ke barabar bhi jis ke dil mein khair ya iman hoga us ki rooh bhi qabz ho jayegi. Yahan tak ke agar koi shakhs kisi pahad ki khoh mein ghus gaya hoga to yeh hawa wahin ja kar use fana kar degi. Ab zameen par sirf bad log reh jayenge jo parindon jaise halke aur chopayon jaise be-aqal honge. In mein se bhalai burai ki tameez uth jayegi, in ke paas Shaitan pahunche ga aur kahe ga tum sharmate nahin? Ke buton ki parastish chhore baithe ho? Yeh but parasti shuru kar denge. Allah inhein roziyan pahunchata rahe ga aur khush-o-khurram rakhe ga. Yeh isi masti mein honge ke Soor phoonkne ka hukm mil jayega. Jis ke kaan mein aawaz padi wahin dayen bayen lautne laga, sab se pehle use woh shakhs sunay ga jo apne oont ke liye hauz theek thaak kar raha hoga, sunte hi behosh ho jayega aur sab log behosh hona shuru ho jayenge. Phir Allah Ta'ala misl-e-shabnam ke barish barsayega jis se logon ke jism uthne lagenge. Phir doosra nafkha phoonka jaye ga jis se sab uth khare honge. Wahin aawaz lage gi ke logo! Apne Rab ke paas chalo. Wahan thehro tum se sawal jawab hoga, phir farmaya jaye ga ke aag ka hissa nikalo. Poocha jaye ga ke kitnon mein se kitne? To farmaya jaye ga ke har hazaar mein se nau sau ninnanve (999). Yeh hoga woh din jo bachon ko boorha kar de. Yeh hoga woh din jab pindli (tajalli-e-Rab) ki ziyarat karayi jaye gi. Pehla nafkha to ghabrahat ka nafkha hoga, doosra behoshi aur maut ka aur teesra dobara jee kar Rabbul Aalameen ke darbar mein pesh hone ka. Atuhu ki qira'at Alif ke madd ke sath bhi marwi hai.

Har ek zaleel-o-khwar ho kar, past-o-lachar ho kar, bebas aur majboor ho kar, matahat aur mehkoom ho kar Allah ke samne hazir hoga. Ek se bhi ban na paregi ke uski hukm-aduli kare. Jaise farman hai ayat (YAWMA YAD'UKUM FATASTAJIBUNA BIHAMDIHI WA TAZUNNUNA IN LABISTUM ILLA QALILA) (Surah (Al-Isra: 52). Jis din Allah tumhein bulayega aur tum uski hamd bayan karte hue uski farmanbardari karoge aur ayat mein hai ke phir jab woh tumhein zameen se bulayega to tum sab nikal khade hoge. Soor ki hadith mein hai ke tamam ruhein soor ke surakh mein rakhi jayengi aur jab jism qabron se uth rahe honge. Soor phoonk diya jayega, ruhein udne lengi, mominon ki ruhein noorani hongi, kafiron ki ruhein andhere aur zulmat wali hongi. Rabb-ul-Aalameen Khaliq-e-Kul farma dega, mere jalal ki, meri izzat ki qasam hai har rooh apne badan mein chali jaye. Jis tarah zehar rag-o-paye mein sarayat karta hai, is tarah ruhein apne jismon mein phail jayengi aur log apni apni jagah se sar jhaad uth khade honge, jaise farmaya ke us din qabron se is tarah jaldi niklenge jis tarah apni ibadat-gah ki taraf daure bhage jate the. Yeh buland pahad jinhein tum gada hua aur jama hua dekh rahe ho, yeh us din udte badalon ki tarah idhar udhar phaile hue aur tukde tukde hue dikhayi denge. Reza reza ho kar yeh chalne phirne lagenge aur aakhir reza reza ho kar benam-o-nishan ho jayenge. Zameen saaf hatheli jaisi baghair kisi oonch neech ke ho jayegi. Yeh hai sifat us Sanna' ki jiski har sifat hikmat wali, mazboot, pukhta aur aala hoti hai. Jiski aala tar qudrat insani samajh mein nahin aa sakti. Bandon ke tamam aamal khair-o-shar se woh waqif hai, har ek fe'l ki saza jaza woh zaroor dega. Is ikhtisar ke baad tafseel bayan farmayi ke neki, ikhlas, tauheed le kar jo aayega woh ek ke badle das payega aur us din ki ghabrahat se nadar rahega aur log ghabrahat mein, azab mein honge. Yeh aman mein, sawab mein hoga, buland-o-bala bala-khanon mein rahat-o-itminan se hoga. Aur jiski buraiyan hi buraiyan hon ya jiski buraiyan bhalaiyon se zyada hon use unka badla milega. Apni apni karni, apni apni bharni. Aksar mufassireen se marwi hai ke burai se murad shirk hai.)

Soor phoonk diya jayega, ruhein udne lengi, mominon ki ruhein noorani hongi, kafiron ki ruhein andhere aur zulmat wali hongi. Rabb-ul-Aalameen Khaliq-e-Kul farma dega, mere jalal ki, meri izzat ki qasam hai har rooh apne badan mein chali jaye. Jis tarah zehar rag-o-paye mein sarayat karta hai, is tarah ruhein apne jismon mein phail jayengi aur log apni apni jagah se sar jhaad uth khade honge, jaise farmaya ke us din qabron se is tarah jaldi niklenge jis tarah apni ibadat-gah ki taraf daure bhage jate the. Yeh buland pahad jinhein tum gada hua aur jama hua dekh rahe ho, yeh us din udte badalon ki tarah idhar udhar phaile hue aur tukde tukde hue dikhayi denge. Reza reza ho kar yeh chalne phirne lagenge aur aakhir reza reza ho kar benam-o-nishan ho jayenge. Zameen saaf hatheli jaisi baghair kisi oonch neech ke ho jayegi. Yeh hai sifat us Sanna' ki jiski har sifat hikmat wali, mazboot, pukhta aur aala hoti hai. Jiski aala tar qudrat insani samajh mein nahin aa sakti. Bandon ke tamam aamal khair-o-shar se woh waqif hai, har ek fe'l ki saza jaza woh zaroor dega. Is ikhtisar ke baad tafseel bayan farmayi ke neki, ikhlas, tauheed le kar jo aayega woh ek ke badle das payega aur us din ki ghabrahat se nadar rahega aur log ghabrahat mein, azab mein honge. Yeh aman mein, sawab mein hoga, buland-o-bala bala-khanon mein rahat-o-itminan se hoga. Aur jiski buraiyan hi buraiyan hon ya jiski buraiyan bhalaiyon se zyada hon use unka badla milega. Apni apni karni, apni apni bharni. Aksar mufassireen se marwi hai ke burai se murad shirk hai.)

Allah Ta'ala ko hukm-e-ailan: Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi-e-Mohtaram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke aap logon mein ailan kardein ke main is shehar Makkah ke Rabb ki ibadat ka aur uski farmanbardari ka mamoor hoon. Jaise irshad hai ke ae logon! Agar tumhein mere deen mein shak hai to hua kare, main to jin ki tum ibadat kar rahe ho un ki ibadat hargiz nahin karunga. Main usi Allah ka aabid hoon jo tumhari zindagi maut ka maalik hai. Yahan Makkah Sharif ki taraf rububiyat ki izafat sirf buzurgi aur sharafat ke izhar ke liye hai, jaise farmaya aayat (Falyabudu Rabba Hazal Bait) (Quraish: 3) unhein chahiye ke is shehar ke Rabb ki ibadat karein jis ne unhein auron ki bhook ke waqt aasuda aur auron ke khauf ke waqt be-khauf kar rakha hai. Yahan farmaya ke is shehar ko hurmat-o-izzat wala us ne banaya hai. Jaise Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale din farmaya ke yeh shehar usi waqt se ba-hurmat hai jab Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya hai. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki hurmat dene se hurmat wala hi rahega yahan tak ke Qayamat aajaye, na is ke kaante kaate jayein, na is ka shikar khauf-zada kiya jaye, na is mein giri padi cheez kisi ki uthayi jaye, haan jo pehchan kar maalik ko pohanchana chahe us ke liye jaiz hai. Is ki ghaas bhi na kaati jaye. Yeh hadith bahut si kitabon mein bahut si sanadon ke sath marwi hai, jaise ke ahkaam ki kitabon mein tafseel se majood hai. Walillahil Hamd. Phir is khaas cheez ki malkiyat sabit karke apni aam malkiyat ka zikr farmata hai ke har cheez ka Rabb aur maalik wahi hai. Us ke siwa na koi maalik na mabood. Aur mujhe yeh hukm bhi mila hai ke main muwahid, mukhlis, muti aur farmanbardar ho kar rahoon. Aur mujhe yeh bhi farmaya gaya ke main logon ko Allah ka kalam parh kar sunaoon. Jaise farman hai ke hum yeh aayatein aur yeh hikmat wala zikr tere samne tilawat karte hain. Aur aayat mein hai hum tujhe Musa (A.S) aur Firaun ka sahih waqia sunate hain. Matlab yeh hai ke main Allah ka muballigh hoon, main tumhein jaga raha hoon, tumhein dara raha hoon. Agar meri maan kar raah-e-raast par aaoge to apna bhala karoge aur agar meri na maani to main apne tabligh ke farz ko ada karke sabakdosh ho gaya hoon. Agle Rasoolon (A.S) ne bhi yahi kiya tha, Allah ka kalam pohancha kar apna daaman paak kar liya. Jaise farman hai tujh par sirf pohancha dena hai, hisab hamare zimme hai. Aur farmaya tu sirf dara dene wala hai aur har cheez par wakeel Allah hi hai. Allah ke liye tareef hai jo bandon ki be-khabari mein unhein azab nahin karta balki pehle apna paigham pohanchata hai, apni hujjat tamam karta hai, bhala bura samjha deta hai. Hum tumhein aisi aayatein dikhayenge ke tum khud qail ho jaoge. Jaise farmaya aayat (Sanureehim Aayatina Fil Aafaqi Wa Fi Anfusihim Hatta Yatabayyana Lahum Annahul Haq, Awalam Yakfi Birabbika Annahu Ala Kulli Shai'in Shaheed) (Fussilat: 53).

(Fussilat: 53) Ya'ni hum unhein khud un ke nafs-on mein aur un ke ird-gird aisi nishaniyan dikhayenge ke jin se un par haq zahir ho jaye. Allah Ta'ala tumhare kartoot se ghafil nahin balkay us ka ilm har choti bari cheez ka ihata kiye hue hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai dekho logo! Allah ko kisi cheez se apne amal se ghafil na janna. Woh ek ek machhar se, ek ek patangay se aur ek ek zarray se bakhabar hai. Umar bin Abdul Aziz (R.H) se marvi hai ke agar woh ghafil hota to insaan ke qadmon ke nishan se jinhein hawa mita deti hai ghaflat kar jata lekin woh in nishanat ka bhi hafiz hai aur aalim hai. Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal (R.H) aksar in do sher-on ko parhte thay jo ya to aap ke hain ya kisi aur ke sher: (Iza ma khalauta ad-dahra yawman fala taqul khalawtu wa lakin qul 'alayya raqib) ya'ni jab tu kisi waqt bhi khalwat aur tanhai mein ho to apne aap ko tanha aur akela na samajhna balkay apne Allah ko wahan hazir-o-nazir janna. Woh ek sa'at bhi kisi se ghafil nahin na koi makhfi aur posheeda cheez us ke ilm se bahar hai. Allah ke fazl-o-karam se Surah Naml ki tafsir khatam hui.
